games.summary: Blaze your path as CYTE, a being created to guard the flow of time, as you dash and slam your way through a mysterious enemy’s mechanical army in this first person 3d action game. Fight through a unique science fiction world in the perfect blend of intense combat and lightning-fast movement.

games.name: D
games.summary: A new game from Parco Games.

games.name: D' Mär Lucidium: Grimmgart
games.summary: Begin your journey amid the chaos of the newly reignited War of Divinity and write your own story in this first-person open-world RPG. Express your personality, choose your combat style, and explore the dangerous, living world of Grimmgart.

games.name: DDS x Narcos
games.summary: Spinoff of the hit game Drug Dealer Simulator and the legendary show Narcos. It’s the 1980s, you are a disgraced CIA agent turned drug dealer. You will run your business in Mexico and the US in this story-driven simulator about the life of crime.

games.name: DDoD
games.summary: DDoD is a single-player and co-op tactical roguelite shooter set in the near future, deep inside an abandoned industrial zone. Explore, fight, and mutate your way to the source of a semi-sentient biological AI anomaly.

games.name: DI: Debt is Inevitable
games.summary: DI is an endless wave-based FPS where you must micromanage the ever-increasing shop prices in order to defeat ever-increasing hordes of enemies. Powered by GZDoom.

games.name: DOBA: Dogs Battle Arena
games.summary: All urban packs of dogs need an alpha, and when it comes to rule over parks, dogs have their own ways! Splat pee all around to claim territory or knock your rivals using your crafted set of the craziest skills ever found in a battle arena.

games.name: Dadum The Dice
games.summary: Plan, roll and outsmart your enemies in this turn-based tactical puzzle adventure. Show a higher number to defeat foes, discover new mechanics in every world, and face challenging bosses that twist the rules. Think ahead, take your time… and master the Great Die.

games.name: Dagada's Story
games.summary:
Dive into the depths of a snowy world in this adventure game. Explore a mountain where a tribe of strange creatures, the Daoudaounes, lives among ancient ruins, while seeking answers to the mysteries that surround you.

Dagada's Story is a Puzzle-platformer game inspired by Super Nintendo-era games. This adventure emphasizes the balance between exploration, platforming, and puzzle-solving, with responsive controls and beautiful storytelling.

Particular attention has been given to the creation of the universe and each of its graphical, sound, and game design elements. The animation aims to be smooth and lively, reminiscent of pixel art from such game as Yoshi's island or the Super Mario bros series ...

games.name: Daibadestructor
games.summary: Become a minion of a nefarious corporation and jump into the sea from Odaiba to destroy an underwater base in this easy-to-play retro-style FPS.

games.name: Damnation84
games.summary: Damnation84 is a fast-paced FPS game that uses impulse and propulsion weapons as a means of movement and combat. In this devastated world, eliminate enemies in sequence and complete the levels before your oxygen runs out. You are the last hope, survive and cause damnation.

games.name: Dancing with Ghosts
games.summary: A cozy wholesome narrative about a young teen girl who befriends a ghost that only she can see. Weighed down by the death of her parents, the girl finds healing through friendship, dance, and helping others. Created to share the message of joy and appreciation for the gift of life.

games.name: Danger is Near
games.summary: Danger is Near - sessional hardcore multiplayer shooter that includes several genres: FPS, survival, weapon and combat simulator, RPG with MMO phenomena. The game will immerse you in a realistic gaming environment imbued with a gloomy post-apocalyptic atmosphere...

games.name: Dangerous Connections
games.summary: As a crisis brews in the Soviet Union, all of your skills as special agent Dan Morris are in demand. Explore the dark machinations of your opponents in a gripping story with exciting and unforgettable characters and use weapons and vehicles typical of the time, as well as a series of spy gadgets.

games.name: Dark Dive: The Last Tropic
games.summary: Join the ranks of skilled duppy detective in a Caribbean town where danger lurks at every corner. Catch or fight monsters, build your deck, and uncover the secrets of the town's mysterious mines in this captivating RPG with turn-based combat and gripping story elements.

games.name: Dark Earth
games.summary: Dark Earth is an atmospheric real-time action-adventure set in a dying, sunless world where your choices shape the future of humanity. Explore Sparta, one of the last cities of light, as you unravel a murder plot and fight to survive before darkness consumes you.

games.name: Dark Lessons
games.summary: Can you survive your teacher in this psychological horror game? With only candles for light and trapped in her home, you have to uncover her family's dark secrets. Solve puzzles, connect the dots and escape. But beware: There is someone else playing games with you, and someone who needs your help.

games.name: Dark Mass
games.summary: Dark Mass is a fully underwater horror game. Explore the ruins of a sunken manor and flee from a curse trapped within for centuries. Your choices will decide if you escape or join the lost souls of the abyss.

games.name: Dark Rail
games.summary: Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.

games.name: Dark Watching Chapter 2
games.summary: After the door opens, you find yourself in the shopping mall. At first, everything is quiet, but after a while, you discover dead bodies. You ignore them and continue searching for your sister..

games.name: Dataminers
games.summary: Dataminers is a fast turn-based roguelike where you climb and clear highly secured towers full of data. Outsmart guards and hack terminals in this unique combination of strategy, stealth and Minesweeper.

games.name: Dawn Girl
games.summary: Dawn Girl is a third person 3D anime beauty girl shooting zombie survival game, which takes you into a world attacked by zombies. Players will play as a lonely girl, searching for hope and survival in this shattered world.

games.name: Dawn of Defense
games.summary: Dawn of Defense blends RTS, Tower Defense, and Roguelite progression. In a last defense, lead your tribe against the Empire: Command warriors in battle, fortify defenses, and build an economy as you fight to reclaim your ancestral homeland.

games.name: Dawson Oaks Trailer Park
games.summary: A proximity voice chat social deduction game where criminals must commit secret crimes while a Supervisor hunts them, and a hidden Snitch betrays them from within.

games.name: DayZ
games.summary: DayZ is a hardcore open-world survival game with only one rule: stay alive, no matter what. How long can you survive a post-apocalyptic world? A land overrun with an infected "zombie" population, where you compete with other survivors for limited resources. Will you team up with strangers and stay strong together? Or play as a lone wolf to avoid betrayal? This is DayZ, this is your story.

games.name: Daydream Drifters
games.summary: Dungeons, enemies, items — everything is randomly generated in this roguelike stealth horror. As events occur over time, hiding alone is not enough—you must be ready to fight. Explore three seamlessly connected random dungeons and survive the daydream. And when you awaken, what will you see…?

games.name: Dead 4 Now: Escape Together
games.summary: A 4v1 asymmetrical horror where survivors escape by solving shifting puzzles. Use always-on proximity voice to manage sanity, but speak too loudly and the monster will find you.

games.name: Dead Detective: Zombie Conspiracy
games.summary: Take on the role of Margh, undead private detective, in this humorous and wacky graphic adventure that combines point-and-click mechanics with an elaborate “deaduction” system. Use your brain (or what's left of it) and solve bizarre and unconventional mysteries in a world ruled by zombies.

games.name: Dead Meat
games.summary: Lucia's just killed her husband... probably. Can you get a confession before her lawyers arrive? Use your own words to manipulate, persuade, threaten, or even seduce her into 'fessing up. This billionaire has a terrible secret. And time is running out.

games.name: Deadly Days: Roadtrip
games.summary:
Deadly Days: Roadtrip is an exciting action roguelite, that combines reverse bullet hell gameplay with strategic inventory management.

Start your road trip through the zombie apocalypse! Fight your way through, gain experience and collect items to assemble an epic inventory.

Craft more effective weapons and find out what items you can combine to withstand the ever-increasing waves of zombies.

games.name: Deadly Deals
games.summary: You're a merchant in an antique shop. Buy, sell, develop. Easy as that. Just don't die. One little detail of a profitable location that realtors don't usually tell you...

games.name: Dear Journey...
games.summary: Run your own little travel agency. Plan itineraries with the cards you are dealt. Satisfying traveller moods and needs to help grow your agency’s reputation.

games.name: Dear Passengers
games.summary: Play in co-op as the crew of the worlds worst airline. Your plane is falling apart, your cargo is illegal, and passenger safety barely makes the list.

games.name: DearMyFriend
games.summary: Set off to the unknown world Stargather Land now. The shadow of chaos is shrouding here for so long, a girl from another world shoulders the responsibility of saving this land. Travel with the power of elements until the end of destiny, only fight will lead her to the finish.

games.name: Death By Misstep
games.summary: Death By Misstep is an upcoming First-Person Rhythm, Stealth and Horror game set on a party cruise where a massive massacre by robots is happening.

games.name: Death In Your Dice
games.summary: Can you outwit fate when your turn comes? From now on, all you care about is the game of dice and its consequences. Observe, investigate, act, defend yourself. Time is ticking away, but death will not wait.

games.name: Death Pong
games.summary:
A brutal beer pong game where losers are getting electrocuted.

A skill-based challenge set in an underground bar full of illegal, deadly matches.

games.name: Death Ring
games.summary: Death Ring is a casual action roguelike in which you will have to force your way through hordes of undead in search of the human world’s main artefact. Numerous scenarios of each character’s development based on random dropping items will make your runs unique.

games.name: Death a Live
games.summary: Pack the house in 15 daysbefore your "Yandere Fan" stabs you. Survive a live stage swirling with love and madness in this rhythm-action RPG. Manipulate "Sound" and "Emotion" through rhythm inputs, where your performance and your choices dictate the "Girl Voltage"!

games.name: Death of a Dungslinger
games.summary: Abruptly reincarnated as a dung beetle, you’ll battle a colorful cast of the neighborhood’s baddest bugs as you scoot, scuttle, and shoot your way through charming 3D worlds. Ball up whatever material you can find, then sling it at your foes—or hop on and ride it around to outmaneuver them!

games.name: Death the Guitar
games.summary: "Death the Guitar" is a pop and violent 2D Platformer action game. The player is a killer electric guitar whose owner was murdered, and the goal is to take revenge on the humans by manipulating "sound" and "electricity".

games.name: DecaPolice
games.summary:
DecaPolice, a crime-suspense RPG from Level-5, developers of the Layton series, will be released on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5 and Steam in 2026!

The main character, a rookie detective named Harvard, hunts down criminals in a huge open-world crime-ridden city, traveling back and forth between physical and virtual reality.

games.name: Decay of Worlds
games.summary: A tactical fantasy defense game with RPG elements: Deploy powerful units, wield magic, and lead a band of heroes through dark missions filled with meaningful choices.

games.name: Deck of Haunts
games.summary: Deck of Haunts invites you to become a malevolent Haunted House. Lure humans into your cursed halls, manipulate their fears, and drain their essence to grow your power. Use strategy to build your mansion and expand your dark influence, turning your home into a terrifying, inescapable nightmare.

games.name: Deck of Memories
games.summary: Deck of Memories is a deckbuilding roguelite where you delve into the life of the last lighthouse keeper through immersive card dioramas. Customize your deck with a unique card crafting mechanic, explore fragmented memories, and uncover the secrets of the lighthouse.

games.name: DeckTerra
games.summary: A Medieval 4X Deckbuilder. Lead a kingdom as you build your deck to conquer the map and expand your rule. Develop your technology through the middle ages to improve your army of knights and keep your peasants happy. Develop your trade, religion, science, and military to conquer the continent.

games.name: Deckzin
games.summary: Deckzin is a dungeon crawler deckbuilder with roguelike and RPG elements. Play as fantastic heroes, build and refine legendary decks, adapt to encounters and events in fast-paced runs, defeat powerful bosses, and keep the world’s last light alive.

games.name: Decrepit
games.summary: Decrepit is a first-person action game with souls-like combat where every death drags you back into the depths. Learn the dungeon, master the combat, and find your way out of the forsaken castle.

games.name: Decurion
games.summary: Combine the unique abilities of Mechs and Pilots in strategic synergy. Team up with friends in local co-op to conquer dynamic levels with different geometry, shaping your strategic approach. Watch out for anomalies introducing unexpected challenges as you defend your base and strive to stay alive.

games.name: Deep Alchemy Dungeon
games.summary: D.A.D. is a dungeon crawling game were alchemy skills play crucial role. Young witch ominous plans were destroyed when she was put in a jail. But she founds ancient laboratory full of secrets and new shining perspectives behind the broken wall.

games.name: Deep Dish Dungeon
games.summary: Co-op online multiplayer game where you must unite to survive the treacherous depths of a mysterious dungeon, navigate puzzling passageways and gather resources to improve your camping site. Encounter enemies with diverse behaviors, discover coveted treasures, and unravel enigmas within its depths.

games.name: Deep Hunger
games.summary: A short incremental game about cleaning the ocean, and feeding the insatiable hunger of a deep sea creature.

games.name: Deep Room
games.summary: An anti escape room game where you explore the depths of a mysterious room.

games.name: Deep Siren
games.summary: Deep Siren is a Lovecraftian WWII horror fairytale. When the lone survivor of the USS Siren discovers a mermaid while adrift at sea, he finds himself plunged into a world of supernatural horror fathoms beneath the surface. Utilize unique gameplay mechanics as Alex battles to hold on to his sanity.

games.name: Deeper Still
games.summary: A really hard immersive sim set in a dystopian and nihilistic world. To complete each level, start with a plan by choosing weapons, paths and abilities. Die. Find a better plan. Die again. Repeat until you finish the level. Then replay the levels to find new creative ways to beat them.

games.name: Deepspace Emporium
games.summary: Deepspace Emporium is a gritty shopkeeping sim set in the depths of a sprawling space station. As a former scavenger turned merchant, you trade in goods of varying legality—all while facing rising rent. Navigate a divided society, balance faction demands, and dodge authorities as you try to survive.

games.name: Deg
games.summary: A non-linear pure puzzle game where you solve various puzzles using logical reasoning. Explore unknown puzzles in the game world.

games.name: Degenerate Star
games.summary: Degenerate Star is a surreal sci-fi horror visual novel set on a warped space ship.

games.name: Deliver Together
games.summary: In Deliver Together, You control either (or both) of the two trucks attached to the same loooong trailer. And who's driving? Oh, just you. Or you and a friend. Or maybe eight of you, all screaming different directions at once. Your goal is to reach the finish line in chaotic tracks.

games.name: Delivery Issues
games.summary: Delivery Issues is a side-scrolling package-throwing time-attack action-platformer that tests your package delivery skills against a zany world of characters and events that just happen to make an easy job... difficult.

games.name: Delivery Survivors
games.summary: Delivery Survivors is a survivor-like action roguelite game. Gather powerful relics and weapons, level up your character, create unique builds and slaughter your way through endless minions and bosses in the dungeon.

games.name: Delta
games.summary: Delta is a first-person movement-heavy platformer game focused on physics-based traversal, speedrunning, and mechanical mastery. And somewhere ahead, the one you lost is still waiting.

games.name: Delucid
games.summary: An atmospheric horror game set within an inescapable dream. Trapped in a dark forest, you must explore, forage, and uncover rare ingredients to craft the one potion capable of waking you up.

games.name: Deluge: Raintime
games.summary: Some things don't willingly submit to the games of man, but develop a grudge that sleeps under the soil for decades— An interactive visual novel with psychological and lovecraftian undertones.

games.name: Delve Down Under
games.summary: Delve Down Under is a bullet hell rogue-lite set in wartime Australia, 1941. Play as mutated Aussie heroes battling Nazi occult forces and Dreamtime horrors. Dodge, shoot, and slash through chaotic combat, collect powerful relics, and strategize your way through procedurally generated dungeon runs.

games.name: Delve Survivors
games.summary: An old-school roguelike game with modern survivors-like action! Delve into multiple retro pixelated dungeons where you control the pace with fast, reactive turn based movement and ever expanding skills which enable you to plow through hordes of enemies before escaping with the loot

games.name: Demon Bluff
games.summary: The cards lie! In this single-player social deduction game, demons have infiltrated your village and disguised themselves as allies. Every card you turn over is either a friend or a foe. Can you see through their bluff?

games.name: Demon Kingdom
games.summary: Demon Kingdom is a strategy card game with elements of a interactive novel. Rule the kingdom, solve mysteries, build relationships, and defeat your enemies.

games.name: Demon Tides
games.summary: Explore the open seas and uncover the kingdom's dark secrets as you expressively platform your way across dozens of locales, upgrading your gear every step of the way!

games.name: Demon World: Raya's Way of Life
games.summary: In this turn-based RPG, you play as the mercenary Raya, completing missions with cunning, force, or diplomacy. Benevolent choices may come at a hidden cost, while ruthless ones could end up saving humanity.

games.name: Demondemon Demon Tamer
games.summary: Demondemon Demon Tamer combines swarm-survivor and monster raising. Manage, take care, and train your demons during the day. Survive the swarm of attacking demons at night. Raise your reputation among three factions of demon tamers, and unravel their hidden motives in this doomed city, Laknakarta.

games.name: Deperson
games.summary: Are you ready to step into a dark and mysterious world with Aaron, who is afraid of his own shadow? A file that has been closed for years is opened again, the forgotten ones wake up from their sleep and the silence is broken by screams.

games.name: Deprision
games.summary: Deprision is a psychological horror game that delivers an immersive and terrifying AAA experience. Survive human madness, amnesia's power, and navigate parallel worlds via a deadly virus. Solve your world's problem, survive, prevent more deaths, and escape before it's too late.

games.name: Depth Loop
games.summary: A werewolf game set in a deep-sea lab, where the survival of humanity is at stake—does justice lie with humankind or the werewolves?

games.name: Derelikt
games.summary: Survive the dark corridors of a space station in Saturns orbit in this narrative retro FPS with faithful PS1 aesthetics. Meet over a dozen unique NPCs, manage your inventory, solve puzzles and fight against the eldritch abominations!

games.name: Descent Of Lunaris
games.summary: Investigate a signal emanating from deep within the moon and fight through a dark reflection of human nature. Are you being tested, or punished for the actions of humanity? Descent of Lunaris is a classic dungeon-crawling turn-based RPG inspired by Wizardry and Shin Megami Tensei.

games.name: Design & Conjure
games.summary: Join Dalia, a young witch, in her cozy adventure to fix her hometown. Reconnect with nature and bring beauty back as you clean, decorate, solve light puzzles, and help magical creatures affected by the mysterious corruption.

games.name: Despa
games.summary: DESPA is a fast-paced multiplayer arena shooter built for after-work warriors with more bills than free hours. Neon kill-boxes, railguns, and carbon katanas meet a five-second respawn loop, so every death flips into revenge before your coffee cools.

games.name: Destiny Code
games.summary: A card battle RPG woven with bishojo! In a clash over the relics of a lost civilization, what choices will they make? A dramatic chronicle where strategy and decisions shape fate.

games.name: Detective Fantasia: Excalimurder
games.summary: A dead orphan has been found slashed next to Excalibur... Explore the orphanage to gather clues and uncover the truth in this colorful Game Boy-inspired mystery game, Detective Fantasia: Excalimurder!

games.name: Determinant
games.summary: Post-apocalyptic physics-based open-world survival adventure game. Planned to include combat, base building, crafting, puzzles, survival and a compelling story to drive it. Building will be a core gameplay mechanic where you build structures to overcome challenges and solve puzzles in the world.

games.name: Deus Mantle
games.summary: Craft, build, fight monsters, discover new technologies and explore an infinite procedurally generated world! Delve into unknown worlds to uncover ancient secrets and return home.

games.name: DevilConnection
games.summary: "Shall we do something immoral?" A demon-teasing adventure where you summon unique kemono and gather magical powers to restore the naughty demon "Debirun's" form!

games.name: Devoid
games.summary: Devoid is an immersive journey into the medieval world of vampires who feed on human souls. You will have to put an end to their power with the help of sword and magic. Use an arsenal of tools and magical abilities on your way to defeat the most ancient evil.

games.name: Dice Chess
games.summary: A new-age chess game combined with math. Free to play with your bro offline, your friends or any players online.

games.name: Dice Gambit
games.summary: A turn based tactics game where you roll and allocate dice to control your characters in combat. Completely customize your characters build with a huge array of powers that allow for boundless combinations. All set in a Neo-renaissance metropolis, filled with aristocratic families vying for power.

games.name: Dice Looter
games.summary: Roll the dice to collect loot, combine your gear, and discover powerful builds. Dice Looter is a roguelike autobattler where your hero enters battle to become the greatest warrior among mortals.

games.name: Dice'n'Go
games.summary: Dice’n’Go is a turn-based tactical board game where every roll can change the outcome. Choose your hero, move across a tile-based arena, and use unique abilities to outplay your opponents. Master positioning, timing, and cooldowns to win with both strategy and a bit of luck.

games.name: Dicevaders
games.summary: Build an army of alien invaders to invade the Earth in DiceVaders, the roguelike dice game set in the same universe as StarVaders!

games.name: Diceville
games.summary: Build your city, roll the dice, and outplay your rivals in Diceville — a card-based strategy game inspired by tabletop classics. Trigger building effects, upgrade your HQ, and race to victory in a game of luck, planning, and clever combos.

games.name: Dicewood
games.summary:
Dicewood is a fantasy horror turn-based roguelike deck-builder where adorable forest animals band together to escape the relentless hunter.

Fleeing into a dark, twisted forest filled with ancient horrors, creepy monsters, and cannibal tribes, player must strategically combine different animals, overcome nightmarish foes, and make their way to the river to start a new life.

games.name: Dictatorship Simulator
games.summary: Some people call it a democracy; you: an opportunity. Manipulate a political simulation by playing cards, find the cracks in the system, and turn a perfectly fine democracy into your very own dictatorship.

games.name: Die to Play
games.summary: Die to Play — a deckbuilder with dice, set on a cozy retro computer inside a medieval English mansion filled with horrors and mysteries.

games.name: Dieathlon
games.summary: Chart a course down dangerous mountain slopes with only your shotgun and your reflexes to keep you alive. Blast through obstacles, fend off deadly monsters, and make split-second decisions. Explore multiple routes, each filled with unique hazards and challenges.

games.name: Dig Raiders: Anomaly Extraction
games.summary: DIG Raiders: Anomaly Extraction is a co-op digging sim where you and your crew burrow through 10+ layers of the unknown—team up to uncover the truth, battle rivals, and race to secure alien gems. Dig deep. Extract the anomaly. Get out alive!

games.name: Dig Too Deep
games.summary: Throw goblins at all your problems in this Action Tower Defense Roguelite. Craft upgrades. Choose Perks. Build defenses. Defend your Base! Angry baddies want to turn you to pulp! Stop them the only way you know how: throwing goblins! Don't miss.

games.name: DigSite
games.summary: DigSite is archeology sandbox game located in Egypt where you dig, clean and document artifacts you find. Donate rare artifacts to a museum and build your legacy as a legendary archaeologist.

games.name: Digested
games.summary: Digested is an open-world horror survival game in which you must evade a giant snake intent on eating you alive. Utilize various tools and abilities to formulate an escape strategy, and use the map to navigate through unfamiliar terrain. Locate your extraction pod and don't get digested.

games.name: Digimon Alysion
games.summary: A new Digimon TCG game being developed for mobile.

games.name: Digital Exorcist: CF1_Defrag
games.summary: After the mysterious death of a Superstar Idol, disgraced DATA Agent Sawyer must face his ultimate challenge yet, being an undercover high school teacher while also keeping the Mississipi Inaka safe from Daemonic influence.

games.name: Digital Legacy of Zero
games.summary: Battle with creatures you collect to defeat the evil Ruler of the Digital World. Hack and slash through enemy basements, upgrade your own to achieve ultimate evolutions, and summon legendary beasts using your team. Unlock powerful upgrades with devastating combos to conquer the Digital World.

games.name: Dimakerus
games.summary: Disguise as anyone. Mimic their ways. Ambush your friends. Discover cursed Roman relics in ever-chanading catacombs and wield their might to obliterate those who stand in your way.

games.name: Diner Simulator
games.summary: Run your own cozy diner solo or with friends! Cook, serve, clean, and manage the chaos in this fast-paced restaurant sim. Expand your café, customize your menu, and turn kitchen mayhem into delicious fun — or total disaster!

games.name: Disc Creatures World
games.summary: Embark on a grand adventure through a world full of mysteries, uncovering ‘Discs’ to collect your own party of creatures! Engage in strategic battles, enjoy an assortment of collectables, and meet unique characters along the way. A monster taming RPG with a blend of nostalgia and novelty!

games.name: Discard All Hope
games.summary: Investigate an eldritch mystery in a town under siege, collect and upgrade powerful spells, fight grotesque cultists, twisted creatures, and bio-mechanical invaders in this twin-stick-shooter / Action RPG hybrid.

games.name: DishDash
games.summary: DishDash is a single-player time management restaurant game where you prepare meals, serve customers, and manage limited resources under constant time pressure, turning kitchen chaos into smooth rhythm through speed, focus, and smart decision-making.

games.name: Diskette Dungeon
games.summary: A magical diskette opened a portal in your office, pulling you into endless dungeons where survival depends on adaptation, destruction, and corrupted data collected to reach the next world.

games.name: Disquieted
games.summary: Disquieted is a hand-drawn action platformer set between a dreamlike Naples and an underground world distorted by anxiety. As Connie, fight, dodge, choose power-ups, and face the demons hiding beneath the city.

games.name: Distant Visitant
games.summary: Survive the alien arrival in Distant Visitant, a top-down open-world sandbox. Master talents from marksmanship to cooking while managing hygiene and hydration. Adapt to seasons where winter freezes crops and lakes. Craft, build, hunt, and find survivors. Prepare for them, this is just the start.

games.name: Divided Land
games.summary: Join the fight for survival in a vast medieval open world. Explore, hunt, craft powerful gear, raid and plunder enemy villages, or forge your own path. As darkness falls, the dead awaken—prepare your defenses or seek shelter. Join allies in co-op PvE or test your skills in savage PvP.

games.name: Divine Tactics
games.summary: Lead your team of divine allies to victory in this roguelike autobattler. Position your units, unleash their unique powers, and outsmart rivals in this asynchronous multiplayer competition.

games.name: Do Crimes!
games.summary: Hey, how'd you find this game?? Do Crimes is an upcoming chaotic competitive co-op extraction game where you and your friends drop onto randomized islands and cause criminal mayhem - then try to escape before you're squashed by the law...or just give each other the finger. Do Crimes! Or Don’t!

games.name: Do Not Play
games.summary: "DO NOT PLAY" " is a point-and-click horror adventure. Even if you reach the "truth" that lies beyond playing, we take no responsibility for any phenomena that occurs there. Please handle with extreme caution.

games.name: DoDoon
games.summary: Defend your castle from approaching monsters! Upgrade your defenses and survive all 30 fast-paced waves in this addictive defense shooter.

games.name: DollHouse: Survive or Death
games.summary: "for that child's future." "I must ...... I must to do this. The eight children who came to the mansion were waiting for a series of horrible dreams... A series of horrible nightmares... Who did this? and for what? And who did this for whom...? Only by entering the DollHouse can we find out.

games.name: Dominus Gladiatus
games.summary: Build your Ludus. Train gladiators. Fight for glory. Dominus Gladiatus is a brutal gladiator management simulator where you recruit, train and equip gladiators before sending them into the arenas of ancient Rome.

games.name: Don Memo
games.summary: Don Memo is a brave bull who embarks on one final journey across Costa Rica to rescue his granddaughter and confront Pisuicas. Fight against legends and shadows of the past in this 2D pixel platformer, while carrying the legacy of a family destined to protect the world from evil.

games.name: Don Pepe y sus globos
games.summary: Become a water balloon champion in Don Pepe y sus globos, a projectile based arena fighter for up to 4 players!

games.name: Don't Drive Dead
games.summary: Drive, shoot, and survive huge zombie swarms in a top-down roguelite where you build a squad, upgrade your car, and create wild hero synergies. Procedurally generated characters, weapons and levels.

games.name: Don't Forget the Phone
games.summary: Experience a point & click time management game that puts your multi-tasking to the test. Complete all of your tasks before sunrise, but watch out for anything that may have escaped the lab below.

games.name: Don't Get Caught
games.summary: A stealth platformer where you control both the hero and the cameras. Evade security systems, manipulate switches and keycards, and outsmart the surveillance to escape a high-security lab.

games.name: Don't Get Fired!
games.summary: The company is going under and corporate has made YOU the office manager. Turn things around quick or everyone's doomed. Run the office, keep employees productive, and avoid disasters. Muscle through the workday or automate the grind. Play solo or with friends — just Don't Get Fired!

games.name: Don't Kill Rumble
games.summary: Welcome to DKR a chaotic 6-player party brawler where you bounce, punch, and outwit your friends (or enemies) in explosive arenas full of traps and nonsense. Don’t die. Try not to cry. Blame your controller. It’s all part of the RUMBLE.

games.name: Don't Lose Face!
games.summary: Don't Lose Face! is an abstract simulation game that makes you flustered and laugh until you're exhausted. What you're about to face: multi-tasking torture, facial features that slide down like cream, hilarious physics feedback, abstract random events…

games.name: Don't Mind the Robots
games.summary: Build deadly mazes and outsmart a rogue AI in this strategic tower defense game. Adapt your defenses, use aiming parameters to your advantage, and activate powerful perks to survive increasingly complex waves of incoming robots.

games.name: Don't Wake the Beast
games.summary: In Don't Wake the Beast, a roguelite stealth game, you’ll sneak through ever-changing dungeons to steal precious treasures guarded by deadly beasts. Use your trusty grappling hook to evade traps, outsmart enemies, and solve puzzles. But beware—each treasure you claim makes escaping more dangerous!

games.name: Donnie's Delicious Nuclear Funeral
games.summary: A point-n'-click choose-your-own-adventure game about Susie, a kind girl in the post-apocalypse who must arrange a funeral for her dearly-departed brother Donnie in the town that hates his stupid, dead guts!

games.name: Donut Panic
games.summary: Order up! Donut Panic is an anomaly horror game with a cooking sim twist. Take customer orders. Prepare and serve up delicious donuts. But when the hallucinations appear, run for your life. Your panic room is there for a reason...

games.name: Donutal
games.summary:
You awaken from a cold sleep and suddenly find yourself in the year 2206. What you once knew as the International Space Station is now the International Space Port—a gateway for aliens coming to Earth. Crushed by a massive, unexplained debt, you’re forced into a job you never asked for: Chief Xeno Inspector.

Seems simple enough, just wave in the friendly aliens and turn away the dangerous ones. However, make the wrong call and Earth could be destroyed. No pressure though, right?

games.name: Don’t Return to Wonderland
games.summary: A dark fairy-tale horror adventure inspired by Alice in Wonderland. Use mysterious powers to forge your path and confront the horrors lurking within a world that is both adorable and cruel.

games.name: Doom ChessMaster
games.summary: The end has come. Who will save us? You are the "Player" surviving in ruins. No chosen heroes—only the strong remain. Gather them, plan carefully, use gear to change fate. Truth lies in the wreckage. Dare you play?

games.name: Doomed Crew
games.summary: Co-op Horror for 1-4 players. Dive into a brutal corporate environment, complete deadly objectives for your promised freedom. Trust nothing.

games.name: Doomtrain
games.summary: Hell has gone CORPORATE! DemonCorp's evil executives force demons into eternal overtime. Armed with the powerful DOOMTRAIN, unionize Hell and free the demon workers. Build a medieval steampunk town, upgrade your train and turrets, unionize demon workers, and defeat DemonCorp's corporate overlords!

games.name: Dosmic
games.summary: In a world consumed by darkness, a boy embarks on a perilous journey to rescue a lost girl. Navigate through cosmic horrors and unravel ancient mysteries in this cinematic puzzle-adventure. Experience a hauntingly beautiful tale of despair and hope.​

games.name: Doubumon
games.summary: Doubumon is an RPG monster collecting/battling game. Experience tactical battles as you choose 4 Doubumon to fight with on the battlefield. Grow, evolve, and customize your attacks while developing different strategies in order to win, as you fight and explore your way to become the Doubumon champion.

games.name: Down Forward
games.summary: A fast-paced roguelike FPS where you survive shifting liminal nightmares and VHS-era horrors.

games.name: Dr. Emmerson's Nocturnes
games.summary: Dive into the worlds of the best classic weird fiction and cosmic horror writers. Try out our original approach to bringing literature into the interactive medium. Relax and let Dr. Emmerson guide you through all colors of dread.

games.name: Dr. Finklestein's Marvelous Room
games.summary: Dr. Finklestein's Marvelous Room is a community run experimental story game. With the end of the world fast approaching, Dr. Gumphrey Finklestein announces his plans for a groundbreaking scientific experiment. What will it entail? Does even he know?

games.name: Draculesti
games.summary: Drăculești is a villain-focused reimagining of the classic novel Dracula that shines a light on the shadowy figures of Renfield, Dracula's Brides, and Dracula himself. Be enthralled by the residents of Castle Dracula, and thrill at a dark narrative with strong LGBTQI+ themes.

games.name: Dragon Dinner
games.summary: Cute but chaotic restaurant simulator where you play as a dragon waiter in a fast-paced dining rush. Set tables, serve hungry dragons, deliver the right dishes, and keep the place clean! After each day, customize the layout of the restaurant and learn new abilities to improve.

games.name: Dragon Realms
games.summary: Be the dragon! Customise, upgrade, and dominate a vast fantasy world. Destroy castles, battle foes, gather treasure, and rule Dragon Realms!

games.name: Dragon and Mahjong
games.summary: Dragon & Sparrow is a mahjong-combat roguelite. Play as three unlikely heroes, escape the endless exploitation games, and fight the goblin corporation that owns the city — across three timelines, all to break free from the Debt of Fate.

games.name: Dragon's Brew
games.summary: Dragon's Brew is a board game cafe simulator! Serve customers while fulfilling takeaway orders and delivery requests and build up your reputation in the vibrant seaside town of Pebblebrook. Source and grow your own ingredients, craft a variety of seasonal recipes, and expand your board game collection. Discover and unlock 100+ board games, each with its own effects and bonuses. Pair them with specific menu items to trigger unique effects and create powerful synergies that enhance your cafe’s operations and profits.

games.name: Dragonscale Monastery
games.summary: Tame the mountain peak and create a dragon sanctuary. Carefully expand your monastery and discover the secrets of dragon breeding. Survive harsh winters, limited resources, hunger, cold, and many other adversities. Experience unique survival city-builder in the world of Dragonscale Monastery.

games.name: Drakefall
games.summary: Explore the World of Drakefall in this roguelike deckbuilder. Build your deck, discover powerful items, and journey through swamps and mountain peaks with a familiar playstyle.

games.name: Dread Pilots
games.summary: Dread Pilots is a space survival game where you explore a mysterious and hostile pocket universe called the Dread. Scavenge resources, upgrade your ship, make friends, and fight monsters as you try to carve out a little piece of the Dread for yourself.

games.name: DreadOut 3
games.summary: DreadOut 3 is a third-person horror adventure inspired by Asian - Indonesian urban legend. Follow Linda’s journey as Keepers of the Dark into an interdimensional rabbit hole to find the source of unseen power threatening the balance of light and darkness.

games.name: Dreadline Express
games.summary:
Investigative odyssey into the minds of fading passengers facing the end of the world aboard the last human train.

An adventure game that doesn't set specific goals. It naturally encourages you to make your own decisions and draw your own conclusions, providing a highly immersive experience with a fair amount of story branching.

games.name: Dreadmoor
games.summary: DREADMOOR is a Lovecraftian fishing adventure set in a post-nuclear apocalypse world. Sell your yield, upgrade your boat, build equipment and battle monsters lurking in water and on land. Explore forgotten lands and discover ancient secrets.

games.name: Dreadwinter
games.summary: Dreadwinter is a single-player, fantasy coffee shop RPG, where the game's story and experience is centered around how you play. Whether you want to run a thriving business, explore the world, or just make good coffee, how you run Dreadwinter is up to you!

games.name: Dream Bar Simulator
games.summary: Become the Owner of Your Own Dream Bar! Create unique cocktails. Manage bar resources, buy alcohol and consumables. Expand and customize your bar, buy furniture and interior items, create the most comfortable atmosphere for your clients. Hire unique employees.Reach the top of the bar industry.

games.name: Dream Village
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the cozy world of village life! Set up your home, buy groceries or order home delivery, cook delicious soups, manage your farm and earn real estate. Dream Village - dreams become reality!

games.name: Dreamera: Figment of Dreams
games.summary: Point-and-click puzzle adventure about exploring surreal dream worlds, solving layered environmental puzzles, and navigating between realities through a central Dreamgate.

games.name: Dreem Ascension
games.summary: Explore the Dreemscape Darklands and uncover it's dark secrets in this story-driven survival horror boomer shooter.

games.name: Drift Market
games.summary: Destroy supermarkets, fight absurd bosses, and turn your trolley into a weapon of mass destruction! Drift through chaotic stores as a furious mutant fruit and unleash over-the-top, physics-driven mayhem in this ridiculous smash ‘em up.

games.name: Drifters: Blackout Crew
games.summary: Raid ancient alien temples in a PvE co-op extraction shooter built for tactile VR gunplay. Steal energy for your dying mothership, scavenge rare resources, survive the temple’s defense systems, and decide how deep your crew can push before extraction turns desperate.

games.name: Drinkrime
games.summary: Jin, a talking liquor bottle with supernatural powers, has given you a mission. Face DRINKRIME's cast of unique characters and force them to confess their crimes. Interrogate them together and make those wrongdoers come to terms with their guilt!

games.name: Drive to The Top
games.summary: Jump, Swing and Boost your way to get to the finish as fast as you can! Try beating the level in both single player and 2-player co-op. How fast can you beat the game?

games.name: Driving Rogue
games.summary: Arcade driving meets roguelike chaos - fast, intense, and ridiculously addictive. In Driving Rogue, every run is a new story: the city keeps changing, and you’ll need pure focus to push your score to the limit. After each race, hit the shop and craft your build for the longest streak possible.

games.name: Droid Escape
games.summary: In this adventure, help Droid 07 to overcome challenges, discover mysteries and free your friend from the miniaigas.

games.name: Drone District
games.summary: Drone District is an adrenaline-charged FPV arcade experience that mashes up the flow of Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater with the freedom of Burnout Paradise—but with drones. Master flight tricks, grind power lines, launch off rooftops, chain mid-air stunts, and explore an open world.

games.name: Drownlight
games.summary: Drownlight is a city-building survival simulator set in a flooded world. Build and expand your city around a lighthouse, manage resources, and make moral decisions that shape the fate of the survivors. Secrets lurk in the raging waters, and if the lighthouse goes out, the city may be lost forever.

games.name: Drug Schedule
games.summary: Build your empire! Cook and make illegal drugs, expand your cartel, and outsmart rivals and law enforcement. Play solo or team up in co-op to dominate the underworld! Your empire, your rules. Rise to power! Don't get high on your own dope!

games.name: Drunken Goddess Reflux
games.summary: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.

games.name: Drunken Hog
games.summary: Drunken Hog is a story-driven pub management game focused on brewing, running a bar, and narrative depth. It is set in a small open city where you are free to explore, meet locals, and uncover the story at your own pace.

games.name: Drunken Rogue
games.summary: The rowdy adventures of drunk-as-a-skunk Rogue Lita and Vampire of Demise Endo! Stagger around traps and stumble through demon assaults. Make your way to the dungeon's deepest depths—rumored to contain the most precious of booze!

games.name: Dual Fire Walled City
games.summary: Dual Fire Walled City is a story-driven co-op game for two players. Featuring close friends who grew up together in the Kowloon Walled City, only to be pulled onto vastly different life paths by a twist of fate. Get ready to immerse yourself in a classic Hong Kong-style movie.

games.name: Dub Together
games.summary: Up to six players redub video clips and give them a whole new meaning. You record the scene, then watch every result together and vote. With voice effects, a built-in clip editor and live voting from your Twitch chat.

games.name: Duck Norris Tales
games.summary: Duck Norris Tales is a run and gun action game heavily focused on boss battles. Play as a brave duck saving the world from an alien invasion. Make friends, discover secrets, wield face melting weapons and most of all shoot first and ask questions later.

games.name: Dumb Ways to Party
games.summary: The worlds dumbest party game is here! Play as your favorite Bean, and go head-to-head with up to three other players to become the Dumbest of the Dumb. Will you use skill, sabotage or sheer dumb luck to win?

games.name: Dungeon Baller
games.summary: Pinball meets RPG in this fast-paced roguelike. Launch tiny heroes, battle bumper enemies, and choose your fate through mystery doors. Wield hundreds of powerful items and defeat bosses to reclaim your soul in this retro-inspired reimagining of pinball, where every bounce is a battle.

games.name: Dungeon Gambler: All In, No Out
games.summary: Hit the jackpot in this gambling-infused dungeon crawler. Pay what you owe. Survive the dungeon. Play your cards close to your chest and defeat Skelly.

games.name: Dungeon Sweeper
games.summary: A tactical roguelike that blends classic Minesweeper with auto-battler combat. Flag hidden monsters to avoid fights or trigger them and battle for loot. Explore randomized dungeons, gear up, and survive as long as you can.

games.name: Dungeon Sweeper Plus
games.summary: Expand the world map by uncovering surrounding tiles, aiming to complete your in-game Encyclopedia. Just be careful not to step on dungeon tiles (landmines)!

games.name: Dungeon Tourists
games.summary: Explore procedurally generated dungeons with up to 4 players. Take photos of the curiosities you come across. Throw stuff at them, unlock new floors, get rewards, and complete your collection!

games.name: Dungeon Treaders
games.summary:
A classic-style 3D dungeon crawler that blends nostalgic challenge with modern comfort. Enjoy flexible character creation and a classic world, now with streamlined, trial-and-error gameplay.

Create your character by choosing a name, selecting from five races and eight classes, and form a party of up to six members.

In addition, you can freely replace face icons and full-body portraits with your own images. Build a party that truly reflects your style.

Dungeon Treaders is a classic-style dungeon crawler RPG based on the original web novel Dungeon Settlers (2022 to present), written by the same author.

games.name: Dungeon Ward
games.summary: Dungeon Ward blends fast-paced combat, grid-based movement, and flexible character progression. Level up, master powerful skills, and conquer challenging bosses in this action-packed RPG dungeon crawler.

games.name: DungeonOS
games.summary: Crawl Dungeons, Loot and Equip your Adventurers! Log in to an old-school operating system. Manage your adventurers and use puzzles to damage your enemies. Are you ready to find the five artifacts you always dreamed of?

games.name: Dungeons & Desserts
games.summary: Dungeons & Desserts is a roguelite dungeon crawler where you also manage a pastry shop. Journey through candy-themed realms, gather rare ingredients and craft mouth-watering desserts to sell in your cosy bakery, all while balancing the pressures of a greedy landlord constantly increasing your rent.

games.name: Dungeons & Furries
games.summary: ✨What's more alluring than the charm of fantasy worlds? Answer: the same, but with sex. The more sex and magic, the better. Choose your character’s gender, solve match-three puzzles, enjoy the fully voiced animations, and find out how your story ends!✨

games.name: Dungeons Deep
games.summary: Plunge into the Dungeons Deep! A dark-fantasy ARPG featuring vast underworlds full of horrifying monsters and ancient treasures. Liberate the old lands of Antioch for those who still remain.

games.name: Dungeons and Diners
games.summary: Dungeon and Diners: A Culinary Adventure Awaits! Dive into dungeons with your friends, hunting for exotic ingredients to bring back to your bustling diner. Choose to team up with up to 4 players or enlist the help of adventurers for both dungeon delving and diner duties.

games.name: Dungeons of Dusk
games.summary: Dungeons of DUSK is a classic turn based dungeon crawling RPG that takes place canonically between the episodes of the cult classic FPS. Are you... WORTHY?

games.name: Dungeons of the Amber Griffin
games.summary: Play as a group of daredevils who explore the world of dark fantasy in search of fame, amber and gold. Experience the classic mechanics of the iconic ‘90s Dungeon Crawlers with a new twist. Solve the mystery of the ghost that haunted the ruins and discover a bestiary based on Kashubian beliefs.

games.name: Dunthera
games.summary: Towers have always defended you… Now it’s your turn to keep them standing. Battle unique monsters across diverse maps, each with distinct abilities, looks, and stats. Upgrade your hero and fortify structures to hold the line!

games.name: Dwarf the Dungeonist
games.summary: Turn-based dwarf puzzle crawler: Solve tricky mechanics, explore mysterious dungeons, and survive the depths.

games.name: Dwarven Mining Company
games.summary: Manage your own dwarven mine. Give orders to miners excavating ore and builders providing them with ladders to get deeper and deeper into the underground. Mine iron, copper and even mithrill to satisfy the needs of the dwarven kingdom for the price of a single coffee.

games.name: Dyadem
games.summary: Become the greatest tactician in this love letter to classic handheld SRPGs. It falls to you to forge the bonds of your Prince's followers, develop their skills, and shape their strategies as you fight to reclaim your homeland and save the world.

games.name: Dynamite Dashers
games.summary: Throw bombs, upgrade your skills, and survive endless waves of enemies in this fast-paced roguelike action game. Build your explosive arsenal, discover powerful combos, and see how long you can stay alive!

games.name: Dystopia RPG
games.summary: Dystopia RPG is an 8 bit style fantasy RPG where You lost a duel to a government's shaman and ended up trapped and sealed in a Cell Phone application. Explore the Dungeons, Combat monsters, Collect and Trade Items, Glitch the game & break free.

games.name: E.C.H.O.S
games.summary: E.C.H.O.S is a narrative-driven first-person sci-fi game. Several centuries after Earth’s civilization was destroyed by an unknown cosmic force, humanity begins to awaken. Journey through virtual and real worlds, uncover the truth of a new age, and decide the future of civilization.

games.name: EVO Card
games.summary: EVO Card is a roguelike card game in which players evolve creatures by assembling biological components through deck-building mechanics. Each run features randomized encounters and progression, encouraging strategic adaptation across repeated playthroughs.

games.name: Earn Your Legacy
games.summary: Earn Your Legacy by yourself or with your friends by slaughtering enemies with flashy combos, finding epic loot and powerful upgrades, parkouring around traps and fighting epic bosses!

games.name: Earth Defense Force 6
games.summary: Earth Defense Force 6 is the sixth main entry in the Earth Defense Force series and the direct sequel to Earth Defense Force 5, picking up three years after that game left off. EDF 6 is set on a dying Earth where the alien Primer civilization invades once again.

games.name: Earthborne
games.summary: Explore, fight, craft and develop an automated technological civilization complete with airships and robotic drones!

games.name: Earthion
games.summary:
Earthion is an upcoming aftermarket shooting game developed by Ancient primarily for the Sega Mega Drive. Physical MD versions will be published by SUPERDELUXE GAMES in Japan and by Limited Run Games in North America. The game will also get a 16:9 version for modern platforms.

Earthion is published under the label YKGGG, a brand name covering all the retro-style games developed at Ancient. If Earthion meets success, Ancient will go on the venture of releasing video games designed for retro consoles. A separate version of the game for Arcade was confirmed by Ancient and published by exA-Arcadia, which features a new, exclusive mode that will not be available in the Mega Drive version.

games.name: Earths Edge
games.summary: Earths Edge is a fast co-op movement FPS for 1–4 players. Enter the battlefield from the flying hub with your own fully customizable mech and pilot. Smash through destructible environments, enemy factions and mutated monsters. Double jump, slide, wall-run and shoot your way through Earths Edge.

games.name: Eastwynne
games.summary: Play as either Ester or Sye as they navigate college and life in Eastwynne. A city filled to the brim with magic, high society life, the best of the best businesses, and real estate. Maybe not the best people, but you got everything else.

games.name: EasyCraft Online
games.summary:
EasyCraft is an online idle RPG set in the world of Valoria, where players take on the role of adventurers tasked with rebuilding a fragmented civilization. Choose from three classes: Warrior, Mage, or Archer, each with three advanced subclasses, and embark on a journey of battles, exploration, and conquest.

The game features real-time turn-based manual combat, automated resource gathering battles, over 200 items with random rarities and attributes, item crafting, resource gathering, equipment enchanting, and durability systems. Explore the Crypt, dangerous dungeons filled with monsters and rare rewards. Interact with NPCs like Doll, Mira, Thalos, and Varen in a village that serves as your base of operations.

Features include guilds with collective abilities, a PvP arena, a player marketplace, a pet system, quests, competitive rankings, real-time chat, daily rewards, and appearance customization. Play directly in your browser or through the desktop application.

games.name: EbiTapes
games.summary: Go on an adventure to meet fun new friends, help them out, and create delicious beats along the way! Record the sounds of the world and make your own cool music.

games.name: Ebola 4
games.summary: You open your eyes, it's dark all around. Are you in an underground bunker, alone with your thoughts... or are you not alone there? Fear, apocalypse, darkness swallowed the world, most people are infected. You are at the epicenter... And can you change something?

games.name: Echo Pandemic
games.summary: You are a bat, and the aliens are afraid of you. Stalk occupied towns by echolocation, bite a single host, and let the virus do the rest. A stealth game where your weapon is a disease. Engineer strains, manage outbreaks, and stay invisible. The hunt starts at dusk.

games.name: Echoes
games.summary:
Immerse yourself in a first-person psychological horror experience where every choice matters. Explore a cursed environment shaped by echoes of the past, uncover hidden truths, and reconstruct fragments of a forgotten story.

As you progress, your decisions and interactions will influence the outcome, leading to multiple possible endings. Solve observation-based puzzles, interpret subtle clues, and confront the unsettling presence that lingers in the environment.

games.name: Echoes of Night: The Exodus of the Stars
games.summary: In this world consumed by darkness, where aberrant creatures lurk in the shadows... Prometheus is the only hope. In this action-platformer, you must find lost star fragments and rebuild the constellations to restore light to the universe.

games.name: Echoes of Pinebridge
games.summary: A slice-of-life college story that gradually develops into a supernatural mystery, all guided by your choices.

games.name: Echoes of the Flame
games.summary: Two parties. Alternating perspectives. A story-driven 2.5D turn-based RPG. Master strategic combat with flexible ability builds, unravel the world's deep lore using "Key Words" you discover, and see their fate unfold.

games.name: Echoes of the Stars
games.summary: Echoes of the Stars is a modern action-JRPG standing on the shoulders of the classics. Follow Rin and Eldric in a tale of two souls, bound together by fate in an epic tale of time, space, love, laughter, and the human condition as they challenge those who seek to destroy existence as we know it.

games.name: Echograve
games.summary: Ensure the safety of the underground city. Manage the system through the terminal. Listen and watch carefully. It seems to have already made its way inside...

games.name: Ecliptica
games.summary:
Ecliptica, a survival simulator on a distant, merciless planet where everything is subject to the rigid laws of economics, power and nature.

Nothing is easy here. Resources are limited, the environment is hostile, and the local biosphere perceives you as a threat. To survive, the colonists must collaborate, trade and compete in a fully simulated, responsive economy that responds to every decision of both players and non-fiction characters (NPC).

Explore the procedurally generated open world, base the outposts, create your own corporation, or join one of the many NPC factions competing for territory and survival. Choose diplomacy, trade or domination – every decision you influence the fate of the colony.

games.name: Eden.schemata();
games.summary: EDEN.schemata(); is a multi-ending sci-fi mystery adventure game, featuring headless corpses, a sealed laboratory, a limbless android suspect/heroine, and an amnesiac protagonist. The game design and gradually UI change in reflection of your actions.

games.name: Edenfall: Legacy of the First Wardens
games.summary: Unveil a mystical action-adventure where you shift between human, wolf, raccoon, and raven. Weave fluid combos across forms, purge corruption, and awaken the land’s lost beauty. Together with your spirit fox companion, embark on a soulbound journey of transformation, memory, and inner peace.

games.name: Edge of Memories
games.summary: The Corrosion, a plague of unparalleled proportions, has already ravaged the Astryan continent. On the other side of the world, the continent of Avaris and its nomadic peoples—so far spared from the horrors spawned by this abomination—now stand on the brink of extinction. Eline, an itinerant Soul Whisperer, relentlessly battles the force that turns the once-thriving fauna, flora and humans of this lush land into grotesque abominations. Following a mysterious encounter, a dark power awakens within her, one that may hold the key to ending this apocalypse: the ability to control the Corrosion within her own body.

games.name: Effective Immediately
games.summary: All intergalactic travel passes through the orbital relay checkpoint. Verify ID discrepancies, repair vehicle systems and struggle against ethical dilemmas as you negotiate a shifting political landscape. Report for duty, effective immediately.

games.name: Eggson
games.summary: After being captured by EGG CORP for failing to comply with them, it’s now your mission to escape their facility. Run, jump, and fight your way out in this fast-paced 3D platformer heavily inspired by KARLSON

games.name: Eggspedition
games.summary: Enter the Eggspedition - a terrifying survival horror with dinosaurs! Play solo or team up with up to 4 players to explore unknown planets, abandoned facilities, complete missions, and make daring extractions. It’s inhabited by… dinosaurs. Furious, massive, and very much alive.

games.name: Eidol
games.summary: Craft living statues from Oak, Stone, and Steel. Infiltrate a corrupt guild as you rise through the ranks in this hand-drawn dark fantasy card game set in an ancient world. Every eidol you build is a reflection of your mastery.

games.name: Ekholux
games.summary: Ekholux is a mind-bending VR experience where language collapses and motion speaks. Solve sound-based puzzles, break through walls, and race on gravity-defying rails. Created by VR visionary Hsin-Chien Huang, it’s full-body storytelling like never before.

games.name: Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree
games.summary: The Shadow of the Erdtree is a fully-fledged expansion that features an all-new story set in the Land of Shadow. It adds a whole new map with 70 new weapons, ten new shields, 39 new Talismans, 14 new sorceries, 28 new incantations, 20 new Spirit Ashes, 25 New Ashes of War, 30 new armour sets, and new consumables and craftables.

games.name: Elder's Grace: Rise of the Mobley
games.summary:
Join this epic battle to take back a magical homeland. Help Mobley heroes explore, build, raid and defend in an effort to regain & hold what's rightfully theirs.

Build and protect customized strongholds while creating specialized teams to explore and plunder others.

games.name: Elecade
games.summary: Strike down rampaging machines with chain lightning. Elecade is a 1-bit action game with incremental upgrades, where you power up and climb to the top of a space facility.

games.name: Elemency Island
games.summary: Elemency island is a cozy farm coop game. Plant, raise animals, sell your ressources to unlock technologies and automate your entire farm. Alone, or with your friends, come discover this island full of surprises and unknown creatures.

games.name: Elevator
games.summary: Embark on a journey through The Elevator. This is not a simple trip to the top. Each stop will open your eyes to the mysteries of the Elevator. What floor will it stop on? What will it show? The Elevator decides your fate now!!! From the makers of Elevator: Source comes Elevator, the sequel.

games.name: Elflock
games.summary: Elflock is a single-player third-person adventure. You are a princess returning to your home on the brink of war and it's up to you to navigate the machinations of the nobles surrounding the king. Engage in intricate dialogues and uncover mysteries in this branching fantasy tale!

games.name: Elodya
games.summary: Explore, craft, fight! Uncover the mysteries of the continent of Elodya by meeting interesting characters, completing quests, upgrading your gear and defeating tough bosses!

games.name: Ember & Blade
games.summary:
Become the immortal hunter and stand against the archdemon Asmodeus. Cut through bullet-hell swarms, clash with Souls-like bosses, and harness celestial blessings that
reshape your powers each run. The demons are rising—raise your sword.

games.name: Ember Express
games.summary: Ember Express is a sci-fi light yuri narrative adventure. Step into the role of a junior researcher at megacorporation COSMIC, uncover the truth behind the "Ember" incident, and rekindle a buried memory with your mysterious superior.

games.name: Emojis Battle
games.summary: Emojis Battle is a Tower Defense game where you build your army of Yellow Emojis to match your strategy. Strengthen them to fight Bluemojis, who grow stronger each round, requiring you to adjust to new types of Bluemojis and battle locations. Develop strategies, enhance your army, and make history!

games.name: Encryptid
games.summary: Encryptid is a short FMV horror game about hunting and catching cryptids. Use real-world footage recorded exclusively via the Gameboy Camera to identify, locate and capture iconic creatures of myth and folklore.

games.name: Ending Tau
games.summary: Morph every part of your body with powerful curses. Survive in a fast-paced roguelite world with different mechanics on every journey. Explore an untouched land inspired by a lost folk tale. Set your tribe free by Ending Tau.

games.name: Endless Rails
games.summary: Protect your train with your drones as it rolls through a monster-infested wasteland. Reach new stations to buy new weapons, wagons, and upgrades. Keep rolling until you or the game crashes. Isometric bullet heaven roguelite.

games.name: Endlight
games.summary: Break through and outlast shifting, twisting, chaos. Fly through surreal landscapes desperately trying to get hoops. Dodging is impossible, so start smashing.

games.name: Enginefall
games.summary: Enginefall is a player-driven crafting shooter set on colossal, post-apocalyptic megatrains. Start in the tail alone or with friends as you scavenge, craft, and build your way to First Class. Seize better gear car by car, and escape with high-value loot to upgrade your personal home on the rails.

games.name: England in London
games.summary: England in London is a surrealist satirical dark comedy adventure game with an emphasis on atmosphere, characters and mini-games. Featuring weird looking art, hand drawn animation and an ambient score for when you truly want to be left alone.

games.name: Enlightened
games.summary: Enlightened is a survival horror game with strong focus on puzzle solving. Explore the hotel in which you woke up, find clues about what happened, solve puzzles and find a way out, while surviving horrors that awaits you there.

games.name: Entwine
games.summary: ENTWINE is a terrifying first-person narrative psychological horror game. Explore horrifically detailed environments in a hand-crafted story-driven campaign as you uncover the story of Lucas Hale. Run. Hide. But try not to scream, it might hear you.

games.name: Erebus-9
games.summary: Erebus-9 is an immersive first-person psychological horror. Explore the derelict space station, solve puzzles, and run from the horrors that reside onboard. As you descend deeper into the station, uncover its dark secrets and the tragedy that unfolded.

games.name: Error: Ai.lien
games.summary: "ERROR:Ai.lien" is a bishoujo horror adventure where she watches, learns, and slowly invades your everyday life— ordinary routines twist bit by bit, until the AI’s love transforms into madness.

games.name: Erulean Angel: Fantasy Commander
games.summary: Set out on a grand adventure of exploration, strategy, and mystery in Erulean Angel: Fantasy Commander. Immerse yourself in a handmade world as you craft armies to outwit your opponents in fully simulated autobattler combat.

games.name: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School
games.summary: Class is (back) in session with Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School! Play in solo or co-op and explore an all-new campus, escape life-threatening puzzle rooms, and unravel a conspiracy as old as the school itself — all before the bell rings.

games.name: Escape Tsunami: Take Brainrots!
games.summary: Dive into a chaotic arena where brainrots are scattered everywhere, just waiting to be taken and brought back to safety.

games.name: Escape Velocity
games.summary:
Blow your way out of a collapsing bomb factory!

In Escape Velocity, you play an alien ant named Gerund as they navigate the ruins of their former workplace. Using a prototype demolition tool known as the Starter, break rubble, launch objects, prime cannons, and fling yourself to safety!

games.name: Escape from 8-Bit High
games.summary: When a cursed cassette awakens a sentient Pomodore 64, Cloudydale High is overrun by 8-bit villains! Join alt-rock trio Blueberry Finn—Hank, Duck, and Alex—as they battle mole men, aliens, dinosaurs and more in a bizarre, musical quest to save the world!

games.name: Escape from the Collector
games.summary: In "Escape from the Collector", you will be trapped in an old house full of puzzles and secrets. Explore its rooms searching clues that will guide your adventure. Each puzzle solved brings you closer to freedom or dooms you to be trapped in the Collector's sinister game. Will you be able to escape?

games.name: Escape the Baby Alarm
games.summary: Escape the Baby Alarm is a cozy puzzle adventure about the chaos and love of early parenthood. Solve hand-drawn, escape room-inspired puzzles inside the baby alarm. Find your way out through mashed peas, pacifiers and sleepless nights. Funny, heartfelt, and beautifully illustrated.

games.name: Escape the Doom
games.summary: Master control of your Hypercraft as you race through time to escape the impending Doom. Fly fast and dodge hazards in this endless runner unlike any other.

games.name: Espiocracy
games.summary: Espiocracy is grand strategy game with unique take on the Cold War. Play as an intelligence service (CIA, KGB, Stasi, Mossad, and many more): launch proxy wars, stage coups, steal war plans, assassinate enemies, and tilt world history in your favor.

games.name: Essomenic
games.summary: You are the surgeon navigating patients' memories via crude, retro machinery, under the command of a strange, occult organization. Keep your patients alive long enough to uncover your exact role in this surreal mess of an operation.

games.name: Estilhaço
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a world where technology blurs the boundaries of reality, solve puzzles, or escape from a relentless monster. Are you ready to face the horror lurking in the shadows?

games.name: Eternal Fate: A Journey Begins
games.summary: Old-school style RPG to enjoy a nostalgic tale with difficult and fair gameplay that is fully voiced.

games.name: Eternal Palace Sakura
games.summary: "Eternal Palace Sakura" is a rogue-lite 3D action game where you power up your character and take on thrilling dungeon challenges packed with flashy combat. Step into the shoes of Retla, a brown-skinned, cat-eared dual-wielder, and explore the ever-shifting dream labyrinth!

games.name: Eternal Remnant: The First Chapter
games.summary: Dive into the unforgettable tale of two siblings on the run in this emotional RPG journey. With only their wits and a cursed power too dangerous to control, they must fight, explore and scavenge to survive in an unfamiliar world. Will their bond be strong enough to endure the road ahead?

games.name: Eternity Breaker
games.summary: Build your class, break the cycle. A 2.5D turn-based roguelike where the skills you gain become your class.

games.name: Eternity Guards
games.summary: The main idea of the game is a fantasy alternative to Valhalla. Scandinavian mythology is a thematic focus - the same style, ornaments and atmosphere where heroes fight for a place in eternity, there will be only one.

games.name: Ether Void
games.summary: New York, the 90s. Detective Frank Miller investigates a murder in a grim metropolis. Your window to the truth is an old terminal. Analyze data, crack codes, uncover digital trails. Remember: not everyone here wants you to succeed.

games.name: Ever Flip
games.summary: Ever Flip is an incremental coin-flipping game where consecutive 50% chance wins create powerful streaks, bigger rewards, and increasing automation.

games.name: EverCastle
games.summary: Evercastle is the story of a young girl who sets out on an adventure to the mysterious castle. In this magical action RPG, you must master various spells to overcome monsters and traps, defeat powerful enemies, and reach the castle's depths to rescue beloved family.

games.name: Everhome
games.summary: Become a sky architect in this relaxing, cozy, building and management sim. Meet charming characters and design unique houses just for them! Go shopping for new decorations, renovate their homes and discover the keys to their hearts.

games.name: Exipath
games.summary: A survival horror game about liminality and depersonalization, telling the story of Scarlett Shinohara as she descends into warped recollections of her past in order to uncover her own future. Navigate treacherous rooms through in-between time while avoiding the nightmares of days gone by.

games.name: Exo Helljumper: Descent X
games.summary: Enter the chaotic world of Exo Helljumper: Descent X, filled with mutated foes and lurking dangers. Combine items and strategy to conquer relentless levels. Face unique foes and formidable bosses, test your cunning and skills, and feel the thrill of battle as you push beyond your limits!

games.name: Exodus: Sunflower on the Horizon
games.summary: You're given a chance to find out what really makes the earth turn... But will you like what you see? Exodus is the ultimate sci-fi RPG experience about love, friendship, and deadly monsters.

games.name: Exorcism:Nuo Rituals
games.summary: Exorcism:Nuo Rituals is a horror pazzle game. A late-night delivery goes horribly wrong, pulling you into the city's supernatural underbelly. Saved by Nuo mask, you enter a hidden world where Nuo Masters against unspeakable horrors. But you'll soon discover this mask didn't choose you by accident.

games.name: Exovia
games.summary: Free your mind as you mine an asteroid in zero gravity, creating floaters that drift through the oddly satisfying physics-driven supply chains you design to pave humanity's road to the stars.

games.name: Expedition: Into Darkness
games.summary: Expedition: Into Darkness is a medieval third-person cooperative dungeon crawler and extraction looter. Assemble weapons, customize gear, and join forces with up to four other allies. Survive the ruins—or lose everything you carr

games.name: Expelled from Paradise: The Stellar Angel
games.summary: A brand-new sequel depicting the aftermath of the theatrical anime Expelled from Paradise. The story of Angela and Dingo begins to move once more. This is a full-scale visual novel that weaves a grand science-fiction vision through evocative text and immersive direction.

games.name: Expendabots
games.summary: Expendabots is a 4-player CO-OP horror-extraction game where you and your friends explore ever-changing islands full of danger and secrets. Run, hide, loot abandoned facilities, and extract with your squad before the island is lost.

games.name: Exploration: Light
games.summary: Experience large space ship battles. Uncover the secrets of the mysterious alien race. Upgrade your ship or even start a fleet. Survive

games.name: Explory Story
games.summary: Play as a world famous detective who is stuck inside one of his own works! Be careful and watch your step. The words on the page can come to life.

games.name: External
games.summary: RPG extraction-shooter in a post-apocalyptic setting. Survive in the ruins of the old world, loot gear, level up skills, improve your equipment and shelter. Fight various factions, or complete missions to become their ally.

games.name: FPS Pro Team Manager
games.summary: Recruit and manage the team of FPS players of your dreams, create your own strategies and rise to the top of the world's elite.

games.name: Fablery
games.summary: Take control of legendary Heroes from myths, tales, and legends of every culture. Each Hero has a unique deck reflecting their personality and powers. Enter a tactical card game where strategy and foresight turn every battle into an unforgettable story.

games.name: Face Interrogation
games.summary: Become the detective. Try and outsmart the killer by picking the right way forward. It's up to you to figure out clues, takes notes, then use your Command Computer to unlock and confirm core behaviors in the subject. Once you understand him, you may solve the case. Or you might just end the world.

games.name: Factomancer
games.summary: The Order sends you on a mission. Armed with technology powered by magic, build production chains, plan, transform, optimize, and prepare for the unexpected. In this automation roguelite, the Eye of the Order watches your moves: failure is only a step toward perfection.

games.name: Factor Zoo
games.summary: Factor Zoo is a strategy puzzle game blending Sudoku and betting. Pick 5 lucky cells before each round, then solve the board with Sudoku techniques. Revealed numbers form hands—pairs, straights, or five of a kind—to earn multiplier rewards.

games.name: Factories in Factories in Factories
games.summary: Build a fractal world. Automate the automation of your automation. Put Factories in Factories in Factories.

games.name: Factory Time
games.summary: 2D automation game set in a time loop. Only time anchored factories and knowledge can be carried through multiple loops, until a way to escape time is discovered. Manage factories, production, research and bonuses to reach the end. What will you carry an what will you leave to the mercy of time?

games.name: False Hope
games.summary: False Hope is a survival visual novel set in a winter that doesn't forgive. One camp, rations for four, a fifth on the way. Every choice costs you: who to feed, who to trust, who to let die. Sharp dialogue and one-way forks, where you decide what hope is worth and when it turns into a lie.

games.name: Fangtopia
games.summary: Create your very own spooky realm in this relaxing builder/puzzle game. Shape the landscape, place eerie landmarks, open portals, welcome friendly monsters, lay rails for the ghost train, complete special objectives and admire the playfully fiendish little worlds that you create!

games.name: Fantastic Haven
games.summary: Restore the equilibrium of magic by saving endangered fantasy creatures. Build your shelter to welcome and protect them, explore unique regions, rally neighboring populations to your cause and rehabilitate creatures in their natural environment.
