games.name: Fantasy Life i: The Girl Who Steals Time
games.summary: Fantasy Life i: The Girl Who Steals Time is an RPG life-sim game and the long-awaited sequel to the 3DS classic Fantasy Life. This game will expand on what the original did, blending simulation with traditional action RPG combat mechanics.

games.name: Fantasy Miner: Idle Depths
games.summary: Dig for ore, discover new resources, smelt ingots, and unlock hundreds of upgrades in this fantasy mining idle game. Mine faster, dig deeper, and watch your progress grow.

games.name: Fantasy World Manager
games.summary: Build a massive-scale MMO-themed fantasy world where you design all creatures, objects, quests, events and dungeons. Watch the inhabitants of your world embark on their adventures.

games.name: FantômeRapport: Intermezzo
games.summary: Fantôme Rapport is a multi-genre visual novel that blends romance, horror, and mystery. Uncover the secrets of a ghostly luxury cruise liner and the enigmatic women aboard.

games.name: Farm Renovator
games.summary: Buy a ruined farm and give it its full glory back. Clean, repair, restore, improve. Repair machines, manage the work on your farm, take care of your animals, and choose your development strategy. We're sure you'll have many satisfied customers.

games.name: Farmageddon
games.summary: In this Action Roguelike, defend your farm from waves of enemies attacking with live vegetables. Dodge, catch, and use their own projectiles against them to survive. Uncover the conspiracy driving their revenge—a secret they don't even know themselves.

games.name: Farmbotic
games.summary: Get ready to venture into the world of Farmatic. Prepare to automate the farm work with the help of your trusty bots. Explore and fight your way through the mines. Optimize the transportation of your resources and help the villagers with their tasks. All that alone or with friends!

games.name: Farming & Supermarket: Clicker
games.summary: Click, harvest, and build your own retail empire! In Farming & Supermarket: Clicker, process raw crops into valuable goods, design your store, and sell to customers. Start with a simple click and grow into a massive supermarket tycoon!

games.name: Faro
games.summary: Faro is an immersive visual novel set on a sunless planet. Everyone tries their best to survive in these barren lands. Make your choices as you set forth into this unforgiving world.

games.name: Fast & Fractured
games.summary: Step into typical Spanish sun-baked places and prepare for Fast & Fractured experience, a frenetic physics-based driving shooter for up to 8 contenders— in a chaotic multiplayer battle royale. Choose from 4 colorful elderly characters and battle in stereotypical Spanish maps

games.name: Fat Goblins
games.summary: Prepare for goblin-packed, hat-stealing, and princess-fattening team based 16v16 combat! Siege the castle walls, rescue your pudgy princess, fatten up the enemy princess with delicious meat, unlock new hats & weapons, and kill each other repeatedly in silly and chaotic PvP war!

games.name: Fatal Dopamine
games.summary: Play as a nameless gambler who arrives at a mysterious gambling table, constantly challenging different opponents. At this table, the stakes are not money but life itself.

games.name: Fatberg
games.summary: You, a lowly janitor, have been forced to go into the sewers to remove blockages that will cause a flood. But the inhabitants of this dark, slimy, stinking, writhing underworld do not like to be disturbed and will not let you leave alive.

games.name: Fate Trigger
games.summary: Fate Trigger is a 3D Anime-style, hero-based tactical shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5. Dive into a dynamic world of floating islands, become a sharpshooter with extraordinary special skills, craft your own strategies, and engage in thrilling, spectacular life-or-death showdowns!

games.name: Fate's Masquerade
games.summary: In this animated manhwa-inspired romance fantasy, toy with princes behind their perfect masks. Fall in love? Maybe. Make them fall for you? Absolutely. You are unpredictable, audacious, and just unhinged enough to make history. Heroine or villainess? Why not both?

games.name: Fate’s Loop
games.summary: An upcoming souls-like RPG game. It is a stylised medieval fantasy adventure where you play as Thalor, a retired hero who must save their village from a time loop curse.

games.name: Fay Keeper
games.summary: Battle, catch, and morph hundreds of Fays in this new turn-based creature collector RPG! Traverse the vast realm of The Faylands, filled with bustling cities, challenging dungeons and arenas, hidden routes and unpredictable weather. Ascend ranks to become the ultimate Fay Keeper!

games.name: Feast of the Beast: Unleashed
games.summary: "Top-down action and survival shooter, playable solo or cooperatively. Explore Valachia with your brother and face off against humans, lycanthropes, and rival vampire clans as you advance towards the origin of TOX-Z, the toxin that consumes the world."

games.name: Fecal Freighter
games.summary: Become a sewage truck operator and survive the foul dangers: drive your ZIL, battle sludge demons, complete tasks, explore a grim world, and uncover the mystery of an alien conspiracy.

games.name: Feltopia
games.summary: In this hand-felted, stop-motion "cute-em-up," the realms of Feltopia have been infected by a mysterious Smog Spirit. Skyrider flies on their pegasus through wondrous landscapes to save their magical sheep, transform creatures, and battle bosses on their quest to uncover Feltopia’s secrets.

games.name: Fendershot
games.summary: Intense street racing with some outrageous Race Tech Inspired by Blur, Midnight Club and NFS:U. Split-Screen local multiplayer. Test drive the demo on PC, Mac and SteamOS (Proton)!

games.name: Fetidity
games.summary: Dive into the mysterious and terrifying world of Fetidity and help Mark solve all the puzzles and discover the secret of this place.

games.name: Feudums
games.summary: Feudums is a medieval strategy simulation with a detailed player-to-player vassalage system, full modding support and community-driven narrative. Balance diplomatic, economic, and military aspects while making your play for the throne. Is it your destiny to rule?

games.name: Field of Heroes
games.summary: Swords, sorcery – and soccer. Assemble your orc players in Field of Heroes, the wildest, most radical online sports brawler ever. Conquer existing fields or create your own – but do it as a team. Sharpen your weapons, focus your spells, and SCORE!

games.name: Final Formation
games.summary: Equipped with the Fusion × Transformation “PELL” System! Free Map Side-Scrolling Shooter

games.name: Final Orbit
games.summary: Master the cockpit of highly realistic spacecraft in this Newtonian physics based sim. Take off from surface to space, plot a course between the planets and dock with space stations. Trade commodities or take shipping contracts to buy upgrades and optimize your build - every choice matters.

games.name: Finally a Florist
games.summary: Finally a Florist is a cozy, slice-of-life game where you gather flowers to arrange beautiful bouquets. Explore peaceful landscapes, befriend animals, and fill heartfelt requests from the local villagers as you finally become a florist.

games.name: Financial Freedom
games.summary: Why can't games teach as much as books? I read 50 business books and trainings and made a short funny game about a businessman's journey. Follow the story from a factory worker 🧑‍ to a millionaire!

games.name: Find the Beer
games.summary: The lights have gone out, find as much beer as you can in the set time limit. There is however walls in your way use your flash light to guide your character around in search for the Beer glass.

games.name: Fire & Crown: A Romantic Tale of the Hundred Years' War
games.summary: A historical visual novel about faith, power, and impossible love. Fire & Crown takes place during the Hundred Years’ War, where you must choose between duty and desire as France tears itself apart. Be the reason someone lives—or dies. History may have never loved anyone, but you still might.

games.name: FireFly
games.summary: A momentum-driven 2D platforming adventure where mastering movement unlocks exploration. Leap, slide, and swing through vibrant open maps as a grounded firefly searching for family and hidden secrets.

games.name: Firearms Factory
games.summary: In 1909, your workshop that produced sweet candies for children was hastily turned into a firearms workshop, according to an order from the government. Are you ready to make them win the war?

games.name: Fishing Echoes
games.summary: Step into the cozy realms of Fishing Echoes, a game that beckons you to shorelines filled with rare fish and whispered legends. Ready yourself for the ultimate angling challenge as you embark on a journey to mastery.

games.name: Five Day Detective
games.summary: The Five Day Detective is a point n click whodunnit featuring multiple cases and a twisted sense of humour.

games.name: Five Laps at Freddy's
games.summary:
Welcome to Five Laps at Freddy's, The premier animatronic kart racing circuit featuring you favorite and lovable Fazbear friends! Sponsored by Fazbear Entertainment

Select one of 12 of your favorite animatronic #FNaF characters and race on sixteen tracks set across 4 cups! Each track is based on your favorite locations from Five Nights at Freddy's lore, including Fazbear Hills, Midnight Motorist and more!

games.name: Flap de Clap
games.summary:
Take on Mount Snoepje by flapping your way up with up to three friends. Be careful not to bonk too much or you might end up at the very bottom again.
Hunt for highscores in the endless runner mode, dodging and defeating various enemies and bosses.

games.name: Flashloop
games.summary: Due to engine failure, the ship crashes onto an uninhabited planet. During his research, the captain finds out that the area is inhabited by angry creatures, and the ship was shot down by someone. These mysteries of the dreadful planet will lead the researcher to terrible discoveries

games.name: Flesh Fossil
games.summary: Stranded on a mysterious island overrun by dinosaurs, you must find a way to escape. Uncover the island's past, manage your resources and evade those pursuing you.

games.name: Fleshborn
games.summary: Flesh born is a short incremental game where you are tasked to clean a facility by burning down fleshy growths.

games.name: Flexible Frosty
games.summary: A short and icy GameBoy-style puzzle platformer featuring Frosty, a cute little penguin who can not jump like other penguins.

games.name: Flipper of Eridanus
games.summary: A fantastical sci-fi pinball experience featuring advanced physics, unique table mechanics, mini-games, and a full pinball tutorial!

games.name: Flipping Football Clubs
games.summary:
A roguelite football management game designed around meaningful progression in 1-2 hour play sessions, with each season structured as a single run.

Your aim is to buy and sell football clubs "flipping" them for profit. Each successful Flip becomes progressively more challenging, with cumulative handicaps that carry forward across runs.

games.name: Flipping is Hard
games.summary: A flippin' hard game where rotation is your only motion. Flip, fall, and climb through the land of lost things to return to your boy.

games.name: Floating Frontiers
games.summary: A minimalist strategy game about growing your infinite floating town. Combine wacky 3D blocks to optimize synergies, build idyllic scenery, and chase your high score.

games.name: Flooded Burials
games.summary: Flooded Burials is a top-down action adventure game about exploring a tower buried in the sea. Play trough stages where you have to face combat and platforming challenges, as well as meet and talk to strange creatures.

games.name: Floral Flowlove
games.summary: On that day, I saw an angel.

games.name: Flowers to Honey
games.summary: A cozy incremental where you choose how your bees evolve, plant flowers, guide your hive, and grow a thriving honey empire.

games.name: Fly Cowboy Online
games.summary: Fly Cowboy Online- is a massive free-to-play multiplayer online game centered around a faction war for strategic resources amidst the ruins of civilization. Fierce aerial battles in the devastated world of Naviika await you-conquer the skies or burn trying.

games.name: Folklore Hunter
games.summary: You are a hunter world reknowned for slaying supernatural beasts. Your next contract is to hunt down a wendigo plaguing a section of woods in north america. Gather resources, set traps, prepare your equipment, use your hunters instincts and take down the beast, before it hunts you.

games.name: Followers of Krow
games.summary: Possess yourself an adventurer in this roguelike autobattler! Train their bodies, teach them powerful abilities, explore the world of fantasy to find them powerful equipment, ancient runes and relics. Seek out your enemies and... whether they die is up to Krow.

games.name: Food Devils
games.summary: You're the last chef in a post-apocalyptic world. Attract adventurers with monstrous food, make them sign contracts with the Food Devils and organize expeditions to collect wicked ingredients! Customize your characters, build the perfect restaurant and plan every move in this Strategy-RPG Roguelike.

games.name: Fool King
games.summary: Fool King is a tactical autobattler where you build a powerful army on your road to challenging the immortal Fool King. Upgrade your units, bolster their stats and strategically place them on the battlefield to get the better of your opponents.

games.name: Foosball Manager
games.summary: Foosball Manager is a singleplayer table football management game.

games.name: Football Club Inside
games.summary: Lead a small football club through one unforgettable season. Make tough choices, face the media, manage morale and ambition — every decision shapes your story in this cinematic, story-driven football management drama.

games.name: ForMind
games.summary: Formind is a hardcore third-person survival horror with RPG elements, set within the collapsing underwater complex Zirotech. Waking from cryosleep with amnesia, you find yourself trapped on a station swarming with monsters that don't just kill—they learn. Every mistake you make makes them stronger, and every victory demands a new tactic. In the crushing abyss of the ocean, your survival depends on one thing: can you adapt faster than the shadows hunting you?

games.name: Forestless
games.summary: Forestless is an atmospheric psychological adventure where you'll journey through a world of fears armed only with a magical arrow of hope. Explore biomes that embody human nightmares - from misty wastelands of loneliness to scorched deserts of loss.

games.name: Forge the Fates
games.summary: This roguelike deckbuilder transforms your classic hand of cards into a grid of runes. Play a rune and the ones behind it shift forward, so every move shapes what’s next. Build a unique deck, trigger match-3 combos, and outplay your enemies.

games.name: Forgotten House
games.summary: Try to escape from the old grandfather from his decrepit house by solving riddles. The game is inspired by Gnarled hag

games.name: Formula 2.5
games.summary: A retro-style 2.5D arcade racing game inspired by the golden era of Formula 1. Drive through four decades of racing history, master cockpit-view controls, and battle changing weather conditions across iconic circuits like Monaco.

games.name: Fortune Teller Simulator
games.summary: Step behind the curtain of an occult salon on a Victorian street of London. Play as a Fortune-teller who decides fates with Tarot readings.

games.name: Four Hundred Catapults
games.summary: City builder & Survival. When the dead get close enough, they can use the deadly fog to take control of your settlements. Build a strong economy to supply your warriors with long-range weapons and massive fortifications. This is the only chance to survive.

games.name: Foxy Dumplings
games.summary: In Foxy Dumplings, you’ll run your own food truck and make friends along the way. Cook dumplings from all over the world, take good care of your clients, and discover how a meal can mend more than just hunger in this cozy cooking sim. Rise to the top of Foxtagram, one heartfelt dish at a time.

games.name: Fractaloid Attacks!
games.summary: Fractaloid Attacks! is an arcade mix of pinball and brick breaker set inside a living digital world. Bounce, glide and blast through fractal caves, unlock powerful technologies, survive chaotic hazards and build your own collection of strange fractaloid creatures.

games.name: Fractured Universe
games.summary: A Turn based RPG with a focus on team building and character development. Explore the Fractured Universe, and what life would be like if the multiverse was destroyed. Featured various art styles and aesthetics.

games.name: Fractured: Snowpine Strangers
games.summary:
Fractured - a psychological episodic horror that exposes the true nightmare of our world.

Fractured: Snowpine Strangers tells the story of Matt, a freight train driver. The endless clatter of the wheels could drive anyone insane, but Matt finds a strange comfort in it. Until this run.
Days before Christmas, he's called in for one more haul. He has no choice but to leave his family behind. This time, the distance feels different. This time, he's not alone on the rails.

Will he make it back?

games.name: Fragile Existence
games.summary: Take command of the last surviving fleet of humankind in Fragile Existence, a sci-fi RTS with fully 3D planet surfaces and vast solar systems to explore. Dispatch expeditions to find resources, build settlements, construct vital parts and supplies, and evolve your technology to meet new threats.

games.name: Fragment Collapse
games.summary: Fragment Collapse is a satisfying tile matching rogue-like deck-builder where you defragment your hard drive by matching clusters of files. Discover powerful cartridges to upgrade your computer, boost your files with enhancements and build massive combos for file-busting mayhem!

games.name: Frame of Mind: A Game of Thoughts
games.summary: Frame of Mind is a brief and cozy narrative game that lets you discover a character trough thoughts and mementos they find while moving out of their parents home. It's an introspective game, meant to share some experiences a peer-group of neurodivergent queers, including the developer, had growing up.

games.name: Frankenstein's Monster
games.summary: Compete to build the perfect monster. Then unleash it to hunt your rival scientists. - In roguelite single-player, or social hangout multiplayer.

games.name: Frankenstein: Awakening of Horror
games.summary: Frankenstein: Awakening of Horror is an upcoming third-person survival horror game set in a frozen gothic landscape. Players navigate cursed streets, morgues, and Dr. Frankenstein’s laboratory while surviving both brutal creatures and the horrors of his experiments.

games.name: Free Stars: Children of Infinity
games.summary: Experience a stellar space adventure and the sequel to The Ur-Quan Masters. Travel through hyperspace, engage in fast-paced combat, discover weird worlds, and meet a unique cast of truly alien aliens as you uncover a mystery that threatens the galaxy.

games.name: Freestyle Football 2
games.summary: Freestyle Football 2 is a fast-paced, 5v5 match-based online multiplayer soccer game. Each position has a unique role, and you'll utilize a variety of strategies and skills to achieve victory with your team. Stylish play and unique characters transform the pitch into a stage.

games.name: Fri: The Unforgettable City
games.summary: An adventure game where your choices change the world. Fri, a girl working at a coffee workshop, lives in a town that feels strangely mysterious. What will she encounter in this town while suffering from amnesia, and how will the world changing?

games.name: FriendOS
games.summary: FriendOS is a singleplayer/online bullet-hell RPG set within a virus-infected computer. Customize your Friend and team up with others to fish, socialize, and explore the depths of a dying operating system.

games.name: Friends of a Feather
games.summary: An absurd adventure RPG: ruin weddings, break into dinosaur mansions, and sleep with 3 or 4 opossums.

games.name: Friendship vs The World
games.summary:
A wholesomely chaotic 1-4 player co-op game! Craft your friends into HEROES and deploy them into battle against increasingly bizarre waves of enemies.

It's you and your friends against the world... Prove that the POWER OF YOUR FRIENDSHIP can overcome anything!

games.name: Frob
games.summary: The happy life of a whimsical little frog called Frob was turned upside down when his tadpoles were tadnapped by a heron. Now it's his quest to collect them all in this silly 3D platformer!

games.name: Frog Legs
games.summary: A short, single-player horror action game starring Carl, the suburban house frog. Will you be able to conquer arcade challenges, solve puzzles, and Ribbit and Tear your way back to the life you once knew?

games.name: Frog Up!
games.summary: Jump, Rise, and Pose! This 3D action game challenges you to climb steps from a third-person view. Score points with each jump and aim to reach the goal—but don't fall into the water! You can strike a cool pose to get special items. The cooler the pose, the better the rewards. How high can you go?

games.name: Froggo's Adventure: Drifting Sky
games.summary: A 2D side-scrolling platformer with cute and dreamlike aesthetics. The ever growing colossal tree known as "the witch's hand" is growing out of control. Froggo sets foot on a journey to investigate the tree in hopes of finding a solution to save his home.

games.name: From Basement with Love
games.summary: Conduct a high-stakes espionage operation at the peak of the Cold War. Intercept and decipher encrypted communications to uncover a hidden threat. Break codes, manipulate targets through social engineering, connect the dots, and escape before it's too late.

games.name: Front Page
games.summary:
Front Page is a 1-bit narrative game where you play as the editor-in-chief of an independent newspaper and you are in charge of publishing daily front pages.
Through a story with multiple endings where choices have consequences, you decide the direction your newspaper is taking by picking the articles from a pool that changes every day.

games.name: Frontier Control: Invasion
games.summary: Frontier Control: Invasion is a Real-Time Strategy survival game in which you play the commander of a human space colony under the attack of outer space robots. Build your base, train your colony, and fight herds of enemies and bosses.

games.name: FrostFire: Battle Frenzy
games.summary: This is FrostFire -Battle Frenzy-, a 2D anime fighting game perfect for new and experienced players of the genre.

games.name: Frostliner
games.summary: The moon shattered. The world froze. Take command of a nomadic train city hurtling through a war-ravaged frozen wasteland. In this survival city builder on rails, gather survivors, scavenge resources, and do whatever it takes to keep the engine running and stay ahead of the frost.

games.name: Frostrail
games.summary: Through the frost, death follows the tracks. Dive into a ruthless open world survival FPS, solo or co-op. Explore, scavenge, craft and fight to endure a frozen, corrupted world. Operate and upgrade your steam-powered train through an unforgiving wasteland, where every choice is a matter of survival.

games.name: Frozen Feathers
games.summary: Frozen Feathers is a charming multiplayer game where cute penguins engage in fun snowball battles, scoring points in frosty PvP encounters.

games.name: Fruit of Choice
games.summary: Casual arcade game. Stay on the move and survive for a long time. Dash to dodge, attack, and explode bombs!

games.name: Fruitbearer
games.summary: A visceral reimagining of the Suika-style physics puzzler, rebuilt as a punishing dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder. Awaken as forgotten deity of bounty, stripped of grandeur, now facing sunless barrens and monsters. To restore balance, you must grow. To grow, you must sacrifice.

games.name: Full Bet: Fighting Casino
games.summary: A 1v1 turn-based fighting card battle set in a casino!Bet your chips and fight for the right to strike!Luck and strategy, nerve and intellect—everything will be tested ina thrilling battle where the tide can turn in an instant.Outplay your opponent, seize victory, and claim your rewards!

games.name: Full Moon Guildhouse Simulator
games.summary:
Full Moon Guildhouse Simulator is a cozy cooking game where you serve drinks to our loyal guild members! You might even run into some familiar Vtubers!

Man our drinks bar and learn the ins and outs of each station. Each station has different equipment and drinks to master.

Our state of the art coffee station offers espressos, lattes, and americanos!

We have a wide selection of tea and boba combinations at our boba station!

Make something healthy with fruits and vegetables (or not) at our smoothie station!

games.name: Full Steam Undead
games.summary: VR STEAM TRAIN + ZOMBIE ACTION. Zombies infest Necropolis island and Queen Victoria is not best pleased. Grab your shotgun, ride the rune train and slay the undead. It's time to roll: all aboard for undead destruction!

games.name: Fuman Ghoul
games.summary: A two-week story about a girl whose stress summons monsters. Dodge obstacles, defeat enemies, and make it to school on time in this fast-paced action adventure.

games.name: Funeral for the Sun
games.summary: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 500 years of love, death and revolutions. A non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the complex history of a community cursed by supernatural forces.

games.name: Fungiman 2
games.summary: Just another adventure with your friendly neighborhood fungus — nothing to worry about… probably?

games.name: Furcifer's Fungeon
games.summary: Furcifer’s Fungeon is a loot-based dungeon crawler action roguelike. Forge powerful character builds using common, rare and legendary items and upgrade your collection for following runs!

games.name: Furry Defenders​​
games.summary: In Furry Defenders, where the Demon Clan covets the Dragon Veins and incites war among all races, you will play as Cynton, the Dragon Bloodline Warrior. Rally your allies and set masterful traps at crucial passes to outsmart the looming threat of the Demon Army.

games.name: Galactic Economy
games.summary: Can you become a leader in the Galactic Economy? Buy spaceships and spacestations on you way to get some additional income. Roll the dice and see what you can achieve in this board game.

games.name: Galago
games.summary: As night falls, a galago — also known as a bush baby — ventures into suburbia, searching for elusive golden fireflies. But the world is perilous for one so small… Galago is an exploration-platformer, blending puzzle-solving, survival, and mystery.

games.name: Game Company Simulator
games.summary: A weary ex‑developer, tired of pay‑to‑win and toxic workplaces, creates a simulation where you play as a game company boss. Recruit staff, push their potential, battle rivals, and aim to dominate the market with blockbuster hits to reach the pinnacle of success.

games.name: GameChanger: Episode 1
games.summary: Take on the challenge to close the four Portals in this varied 2D-Action-Adventure with shoot 'em up elements! Explore the open Interworld, solve tricky puzzles in complex dungeons, shoot your way through the hordes of counter viruses and stop the dragon!

games.name: Gaming Raiding
games.summary: Third-person shooter games

games.name: Gang of Frogs
games.summary: Sail through the galaxy as a fearless outlaw frog. Plunder loot, upgrade weapons, eat flies and fight through hordes of monstrous bugs in an intense 1-4 player co-op shooter.

games.name: Gap Year
games.summary: Gap Year is a story-focused point & click adventure played through comic book panels that reconfigure as you explore Vera Novak’s one-bedroom apartment. Vera is a bright young scientist, but the arrival of an unexpected guest and a strange fixation with a cosmonaut may derail her academic pursuits.

games.name: Garage Mechanic Simulator 2026
games.summary: Build your own car empire in Garage Mechanics 2026

games.name: Gargoyle Garden
games.summary: Sit back, relax, and grow many magical and mystical plants in your very own greenhouse! Collect rare plants, upgrade your tools, and earn enough money to unlock new greenhouses.

games.name: Gata Guressi
games.summary: Learn to communicate with the people of Hierre by speaking their languages and understanding their cultures in this sci-fi translation game. Use your translation skills to navigate Kallay Tirridor, uncovering its dark secrets while solving the sudden disappearance of your brother.

games.name: Gate Guard Simulator
games.summary: Step into the boots of the castle guard. Inspect seals, expose smugglers and reveal witches. You decide who enters and who’s turned away. Will you uphold the law, or break it for your own gain?

games.name: Gatekeeper of the Yin Dynasty
games.summary: Gatekeeper of the Yin Dynasty is an independent game with a fantasy fairy tale theme, and the core gameplay focuses on "identifying fakes and identifying monsters". Every decision you make is not only about the safety of the people in the city, but also about the profound impact on the entire city

games.name: Gatekeeper's Week
games.summary: Become a guard of the glorious kingdom of Cardenia! Your task is to let only law-abiding travelers into the city, while repelling bandit attacks and sending swindlers to jail! Be attentive and vigilant! For the glory of the King!

games.name: Gear Up Einstein!
games.summary: Einstein becomes your soldier in this tactical multiplayer roguelite where strategy meets history. Lead a squad of legendary figures, craft insane item synergies, and fight through twisted historical timelines. Gear up your team, coordinate with your friends, and save the world in a new way every time!

games.name: Gemcraft: Legacy Collection
games.summary: Experience the original three GemCraft games in one collection. GemCraft 1, GemCraft 0, and GemCraft Labyrinth! Forge and combine magical gems, build deadly defenses, and survive relentless waves in one of the most beloved Flash-era tower defense series!

games.name: Genderman
games.summary: A short, intense psychological horror. Tear up the notes before Genderman finds you — between dark humor, madness, and fear. Meme or nightmare? You decide.

games.name: Gennady
games.summary: An old-school action platformer with rogue-lite elements. Imagine your grumpy neighbor blowing up the backside of an alien world with a blaster instead of resting after his shift. Blood, noir, and green slime.

games.name: Gently Packed
games.summary: Gently Packed is a relaxing cozy sim where you step into the shoes of a cashier working in a charming, cartoon-style supermarket! Your main task is to scan products and pack them thoughtfully, considering shape, weight, and fragility. The better you serve your customers, the bigger the tips you'll receive! But that's not all - as the owner of a franchise for a major corporation, you'll also manage your store, upgrade it, and pay off the loan you took to start your business.

games.name: Get It Up!
games.summary: Can you make it to the top while balancing the stick on your head?ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤ...probably not. It's pretty hard.

games.name: Get to Work, Gnomes! Christmas Factory
games.summary: Run a chaotic Christmas gift factory with mischievous gnomes! Get to Work, Gnomes! Christmas Factory is a short management game where you prepare gifts for children before Christmas. Package gifts, build production lines, manage gnomes, and assign tasks to turn a workshop into an efficient factory.

games.name: Ghost Golfing
games.summary: Swing on to Ghost Golfing. Build haunting mini golf courses to ricochet, blow, burn or teleport the ball right in to the hole!

games.name: Ghost Scout
games.summary: Identify invisible ghosts using mundane and strange objects. Find the Anchor without getting killed, reveal the ghosts true form and attempt to get out alive.

games.name: Ghost Sector
games.summary: Ghost Sector is a survival horror game where you play as M-07, a prototype machine trapped in a cybernetic facility during lockdown. Outwit the automated defenses, search for answers to your origin uncovering secrets, solving puzzles, and upgrade your abilities while preserving your finite energy.

games.name: Ghost Vanguard
games.summary: Ghost Vanguard is a Beat'em Up game that combines stylish action with roguelike elements. Grab your sword and step into treacherous evil dungeons, using stylish and magnificent combos to defeat the sinister forces from the darkness!

games.name: Ghosts With Hats
games.summary: Ghosts With Hats is a fast-paced top-down arcade racing game where ghosts compete on dynamic tracks. Collect relics, upgrade your unique character, and dash to victory!

games.name: Gido Gido: Kaiju Battle Party
games.summary: A chaotic 4v4 party brawl is about to go down! Control your giant cuddly combative creatures in a cozy city you can smash to pieces, and fuse with your teammates into even bigger kaiju you collectively control for more devastation. Unleash the mayhem and let's gooooo!

games.name: Gig Crawler
games.summary: GigCrawler is a co-op roguelite where Freelancers swap abilities, prepare builds, and tackle procedurally generated, biome-coded dungeons. Adapt, grind, and survive the gig chaos!

games.name: Gilded Destiny
games.summary: Gilded Destiny is a grand strategy game depicting the transformative era of the Industrial Revolution. You will take the helm of the country of your choice and transform it from a backward agrarian society to an industrial powerhouse.

games.name: Gingerbread Holiday
games.summary: Learn to love a broken Holiday through romance. Build a gingerbread house as you form your new home.

games.name: Giri-Jump Star Rush
games.summary: "Giri-Jump Star Rush" is a 2D jump action game featuring a classic gameplay feel. Have fun with a diverse range of stages themed around "Giri-Jump," where you leap right from the edge of the platform.

games.name: Girl & Scarecrow
games.summary: Something rotten roams the night. Venture deep into the woods behind your grandfather's house and track down an aviary lost to time in this fantasy visual novel game set in rural New Zealand.

games.name: Girl of the Ruins
games.summary: “Girl of the Ruins” is a horror-mystery adventure game set in the future. One day, a girl who looks exactly like you suddenly appears. As you follow this suspicious girl, you will eventually uncover the truth of the world.

games.name: Glaciered
games.summary: Glaciered is an action-adventure indie game that takes place on a glacier-covered Earth 65 million years in the future. Play as a Tuai, a species evolved from birds, to soar through the seas and fight against the threats to this new golden age of life.

games.name: Gladiators of Roma Revixit
games.summary: Gladiators of Roma Revixit is a unique, story-driven roguelike, set in world in which, after the nuclear fallout, a new Rome and thus a new colosseum rises from the radioactive-ashes. Rise the ranks, enjoy the celebrity of being a Gladiator, and make decisions that impact the story.

games.name: GlagStone
games.summary: GlagStone is a story-driven city-builder set on a mysterious island between warring nations, brought to life in a stark black-and-white style. Rebuild a fading settlement, guide its people through hardship, and uncover secrets hidden in diaries, ruins, and the depths of the lake.

games.name: Gloctopus
games.summary: It's you, and 8 glocs, up against the whole ocean - are you up to the task? Gloctopus is a fast paced 2D Roguelike shooter about a gun-wielding octopus on a mission to stop a nuclear warhead from destroying the world.

games.name: Gluttony
games.summary: In the 2D action roguelike Gluttony, devour endless waves of Food Devils! Swallow enemies whole to steal their powers, then explode when your belly is full. Constantly decide where to move, who to eat, and which powers to upgrade. Without razor-sharp judgment, survival is impossible.

games.name: Goblin's Journey
games.summary: Goblin's Journey is a humorous adventure game with a stupid plot and even more idiotic characters. You play as a greedy bastard goblin named Alastar. You are about to save you king's life - in exchange for gold of course! An adventure full of gold, mischief and innapropriate content.

games.name: God of Chaos
games.summary: Defy nature’s laws and avenge your slain pantheon! Humanity once feared and hated you, but now, awakened from a thousand-year slumber, you are their only hope. A text-based interactive game.

games.name: God of Stocks
games.summary: An incremental management game about manipulating the market to get filthy rich. Buy low, sell high, chain absurd combos and earn divine blessings from stock market gods. Will you play it safe or risk everything?

games.name: God, Save the Queens!
games.summary: You are God. The king’s five daughters have been taken. Fight thousands of enemies, unlock powerful skills, and crush the evil wizard Zaharad in this brutal 2.5D roguelike!

games.name: Gods, Death & Reapers
games.summary: An innovative ExtrAction RPG set in a brutal afterlife where mythology is real and the gods are dead. Fight through PvPvE, Story Mode or Co-Op PvE to claim valuable loot and bring balance to the shattered realms.

games.name: Goeland: Seagull Adventure
games.summary: Take off as a mischievous seagull, and soar into a captivating escapade! From playful pranks to selfless deeds, be the ultimate feathered troublemaker or a helpful hero. Solve puzzles, unravel secrets, and engage with an interactive world. Let your wings decide the fate of this charming adventure!

games.name: Going My Way?
games.summary: In a world consumed by an insomnia pandemic, where there are no laws and people are going crazy, you're a train conductor racing through an endless night blizzard. Study the strange passengers, solve mysteries, and survive the time loop before the snowy abyss swallows you up.

games.name: Golf With Your Friends 2
games.summary: Tee off in Golf With Your Friends 2! Dive into 12-player chaos, wild new course mechanics, a revamped level editor, and nonstop fun—play together no matter how and where your friends play!

games.name: Goman: Stuck in the Avici Hell
games.summary: Goman is a Infinitely looped scroll style battle action game.

games.name: Good Hands
games.summary: In Good Hands, join Nia as she helps her neighbor Aunty Zubeida tidy up a tangled garden. Tend, sort, and restore calm in this cozy puzzle about care and connection. Unwind with over 100 uniquely crafted puzzles, made for anyone who finds joy in gardens.

games.name: Goodbye Page
games.summary:
Page visits the house of her absent father, who has completely disappeared out of the blue. The landlord mentions that, oddly enough, his belongings were left in packaged boxes, but he himself could not be found.

However, her arrival at the house suggests that there is something even stranger about her father’s disappearance than she had expected. What could her father have been hiding? And how will all of this affect Page?

games.name: Gothic Scythe
games.summary: An high-difficulty action game where you must slip past your enemies attacks and crush them. Take back the city controlled by homunculus with your scythe.

games.name: Gothic Steel
games.summary: Gothic Steel is a grimdark, retro, survivor-like, wave shooter. Command a heavily armed tank against the horde, assemble your crew, and forge an unstoppable war machine.

games.name: Gourmet Steak Odyssey
games.summary: A resource management platformer where you play as Sweet Baby Jesus on a quest to make the perfect steak. Use your gun to propel yourself through levels and use your feet viciously to crush your foes.

games.name: Grainhold
games.summary: Grainhold is an open world mining game where player build their own settlement, which they must then defend against waves of enemy attacks. To construct buildings, players must gather resources and grow vegetables, which they can sell to buy better equipment from the merchant.

games.name: Grapple Car
games.summary: A car with a grappling hook! Twist and turn with tight driving controls around colorful tracks to complete challenges, customize your car, and race for a spot at the timed global online leaderboards.

games.name: GrappleBurger
games.summary: GrappleBurger is a high-management cooking game where multitasking is the only way to get your orders out. Master the chaos of the kitchen as you fry, blend, grill, and craft your way up the leaderboards! Do you have what it takes to be a top chef?

games.name: Grav My Balls
games.summary: Grav your balls and let them fly! You are trapped and must use escape with the help of the strange tech built into your hands. Launch your balls to change gravity on objects blocking your path. Use your mind and your new powers to solve gravity and mind bending puzzles.

games.name: Graveyard Keeper II
games.summary: The most inaccurate medieval cemetery sim is back! Restore The Town, manage the graveyard, automate production, lead your undead army into battle and turn the zombie problem into a thriving business! Graveyard Keeper 2 is the grotesque sequel that's deeper than six feet, and more unhinged than ever!

games.name: GraviTech
games.summary: In this 3D puzzle you will need to turn your perception of the world. After all, the actions of the game take place in the laboratory on the study of gravity changes. Forget about the attraction to the ground.

games.name: Gravitee Wars
games.summary: Battle across the galaxy in this turn-based space artillery game. Use the gravity of destructible planets to launch your shots at the enemy until only one team remains.Unlock new gear for your team members in the single player campaign and online multiplayer modes.

games.name: Gravity Blasters
games.summary: Gravity Blasters is a fast, fun and addictive multiplayer artillery action game that is recreating the classic artillery style of aiming and shooting by adjusting the angle and power.

games.name: Graytail
games.summary: Graytail is a Zelda-like action-adventure game with interactive puzzles and combat set on a small island in the Pacific. Find the missing best female pilot and uncover the secrets hidden on the island.

games.name: Greed Realm
games.summary: Greed Realm is a Roguelike Deckbuilder fused with Monopoly elements. As Priestess Gladis, enter the "Soul Tree" to cure your mother. Master deck building, dice manipulation, and backpack management to survive the gap between desire and nightmare.

games.name: Greedy Little Kingdoms
games.summary: A short-run roguelike city builder. Gather timber, craft crowbars and magic potions, fulfill demands from frogs, plague doctors, and swamp dragons. Explore the hex map, survive the King's moods, and find the artefacts that break your economy wide open. Repeat.

games.name: Green Mist Over Portland
games.summary: A detective noir puzzle deduction game. Explore a non-linear timeline during the cold war on a globe-trotting adventure following a trail of spies from a quiet English harbour town to a frozen Finnish fishing village and the corridors of an intelligence service rotten at its core.

games.name: Greenfeet Haven
games.summary: Greenfeet Haven is a colony sim set in a fantasy world where you start from nothing into the wild. Cultivate the land, collect resources, craft valuable items and discover new technologies. Organize your village according to your desires, then watch your inhabitants lead their daily lives!

games.name: Greta Sees Ghosts!
games.summary: Greta Sees Ghosts! is a lovingly crafted cozy adventure filled with quirky ghosts, witty dialogue, and clever shape-based puzzles. Explore remote islands, help the dead move on, and uncover Greta’s quietly touching story — one odd encounter at a time.

games.name: Grid
games.summary: Grid Slash is a fast-paced, grid-based visual debugging action game where you dive into consecutive battles and wipe out system-breaking bugs.

games.name: Grilluminati
games.summary: Start a cult with friends and summon one of three rivalling gods. Sacrifice customers, perform dark rituals and work together to bring an ancient evil being into the world, all under the cover of a steakhouse.

games.name: Grim Dice
games.summary: Dark medieval times. Face off in an online PvP Farkle-like duel where dice combos become damage and greed can cost you victory. Choose a hero, collect items, and defeat your opponent. Risk, strategy, and luck decide who survives.

games.name: Grim Path
games.summary: A card-driven strategy roguelike where every step is a choice. Descend into dark dungeons, battle monsters, face various encounters, and collect powerful items in fast, easy-to-pick-up runs filled with meaningful decisions.

games.name: Grinville
games.summary: An abandoned park, a forgotten tragedy, and something that should never have been awakened. Years ago, a charming parade turned into a massacre when the animatronics, created to entertain, brutally attacked the audience. Now, you return to this cursed place to uncover the truth. But beware... they are still here, waiting.

games.name: Grobnopolis | Last Days
games.summary: You haven't been outside in quite a while. The sky was enveloped by a strange layer of clouds that's been blocking the sunlight for months. Something’s brewing in the air… and now it has found its way into your apartment.

games.name: Groda
games.summary: GRODA is an intense arcade experience, blending nerve-wracking action with precision platforming and rogue elements. Fight, loot, explore!

games.name: Growth
games.summary: Journey to a place where even DEATH doesn’t stop your GROWTH…

games.name: Grubkins
games.summary: An autobattling dungeon-crawler! Hatch them from eggs. Equip them with gear. Lead them into battle! It’s up to you to guide these grubkins from helpless runts into skilled adventurers as you plunge into the depths together.

games.name: Guardians Planetfall
games.summary: From the creators of Guardians Frontline, Guardians Planetfall drops you into a galaxy-wide war for the fate of humanity. Fight assembled into squads of up to 4 soldiers in fast, tactical VR combat across space and dangerous planets filled with aliens, Void soldiers, and massive war machines.

games.name: Guildmaker
games.summary: Run a guild of valiant, procedurally generated adventurers who fight, trade, craft, and do quests on their own. Do your best as their guildmaster to provide them a place to rest and thrive, and restore an old guild to its former glory.

games.name: Guildrun
games.summary: Turn a simple team into an unstoppable force and crush waves of monsters in this PvE autobattler roguelike. No two runs feel the same as you bend heroes beyond their class roles and discover countless combinations and synergies. Seal the rifts at your own pace and uncover what tore them open.

games.name: Gummy Nightmares
games.summary: Step into the enigmatic world of Gummy Nightmares as a little boy who wakes up in a mysterious amusement park with no memory. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover lost memories while evading sinister plushie robots. Use weapons, set traps, and find hideouts to survive and reveal the truth

games.name: Gun Restoration Shop Simulator
games.summary: Run a gun restoration workshop. Take in damaged firearms, dismantle them, and craft missing parts using various tools. Unlock advanced machinery, restore each weapon to its former glory. Track demand, negotiate prices, and run a successful restoration business.

games.name: Gunclone Arena
games.summary: Gunclone Arena is a top-down looter-shooter roguelite. Fight as a super-clone that can wield 6 weapons, a Beam and Shield in a dystopian TV show! Loot thousands of weapon variants with ricochet, detonate, shock, pierce and more. Stack build-changing Mods. Notice: Escape is grounds for perma-recycle.

games.name: Gunjutsu
games.summary: GUNJUTSU combines the score-chasing creativity of Skate 3 with Call of Duty Trickshotting. Learn the basics, master the 'Trickshot Iceberg' and compete on the global leaderboard. If you’ve ever hit a 360, this game was made for you.

games.name: Gunman Contracts: Stand Alone
games.summary: "Gunman Contracts - Stand Alone" is an action-movie inspired shooter playable both in VR and in Non-VR (First Person). As a professional hitman, the player takes on ruthless forces in the criminal underworld, bringing justice and order in the world beyond the reach of law - one contract at a time.

games.name: Gunmetal Gothic
games.summary: A co-op shooter-RPG with a retro-3D aesthetic. Customize and upgrade your character as you take back the city of Vestige from demonic machines!

games.name: Guns are Funs
games.summary:
Guns are Funs is an arcade game that combines elements of a shooter, runner, and tower destruction. Immerse yourself in the world of toy soldiers who wage fierce battles for power and influence in the room. Bright dynamic battles, unique missions, and a variety of game modes await you.

The story campaign is divided into chapters, each offering distinct missions that challenge your skills across different aspects of the game. And if you're looking for some non-stop fun without the narrative, dive into the sandbox mode — where you can explore all game elements and compete for the highest score.

Assemble your army of toys, crush your enemies' towers, and prove that even the smallest soldiers can become the greatest heroes!

games.name: Guns, Princess and Braves
games.summary: Fast-paced Roguelike: inventory management meets tower defense. As a princess in love with a dragon, strategically layout weapons in limited space. Take direct control in battle to crush "righteous" braves with flashy bullet!

games.name: HAFO: Horse Around, Find Out
games.summary: Take control of an elite, equine warrior, defeating jobber jockeys who stand in your way as you race to the finish line, using fierce foreleg punches, hind leg kicks. HAFO isn't your grandsire's horse racing game. Wanna know how? Well Horse Around, and Find Out!

games.name: HR: Human Remains
games.summary: In a broken world ruled by demons, the gears of productivity still turn. Complete tasks, solve puzzles, and explore a society under demonic regime from the perspective of an ordinary office clerk.

games.name: Hack Fate
games.summary: Hack Fate is a fast-paced, cyberpunk pixel-style hack-and-slash action game. In a flash of lightning, control time and space, switch identities, and deliver swift, fatal blows to all enemies. But if it's the heavens you're up against? Then you shall hack fate itself.

games.name: Hair Removal Salon Simulator
games.summary: Experience the oddly satisfying world of laser hair removal! Zap through thick beards, manage your customers' pain levels, and build your hairy empire. Will you run a 5-star luxury salon or a house of screams?

games.name: Half Grip
games.summary: Get hooked on this brutal one-armed rogue-like combat racing game where every action is a gamble. Steer, shoot and reload - each split-second counts as you compete against armed rivals across atmospheric tracks rendered in harsh pixelated detail.

games.name: Half Left
games.summary: Trapped inside a quarantined research complex, a wheelchair-bound nurse must survive a curse beyond human comprehension.

games.name: Handlime
games.summary:
Forget the keyboard! All you need are your hands.

Meet the protagonist of our 2D action-puzzle game "Handlime"—a quirky, hand-shaped slime! Using a webcam, the game tracks your hand movements in real-time, perfectly syncing them with the slime on the screen.

The controls are completely intuitive. Walk by wiggling your fingers as if "tickling" the ground, tilt your hand to move, or make a fist to punch and blast objects away!

games.name: Hannibal
games.summary: Hannibal is a grand strategy game with real-time tactical battles. Choose regions on the campaign map, command your army, and take direct control when war begins. Build formations, break enemy lines, and lead your empire to victory through smart strategy and battlefield decisions.

games.name: Hardcheologist
games.summary: You are an archeologist descending through mysterious and ever-changing ruins using only your weapon's recoil to control the fall. Shoot, try not to touch the ground, reveal secrets and survive. How deep can you go? What lies hidden in the depths of this pyramid?

games.name: Hardkill System
games.summary: Take control of a powerful mech, scavenge for different weapons and upgrades, and complete missions to help the last humans recover from the AI apocalypse in this top-down real-time tactical action-roguelite.

games.name: Hardware Simulator
games.summary: Build your hardware empire from scratch! Experience real business with product sourcing, dynamic pricing, online orders, and delivery management. Boost your popularity, expand your store, and become the country's most successful hardware merchant!

games.name: Hark the Ghoul
games.summary: Slash, kick and magick your way through an adventure brimming with secrets and curious encounters! Hark the Ghoul offers a meticulously handcrafted world to explore.

games.name: Haruka: Beyond the Stars
games.summary: Haruka: Beyond the Stars is a juvenile sci-fi RPG about the intergalactic adventures of the protagonist, Yuuki, and a mysterious girl named Miiya. Set out on a spaceship and explore unique planets. Enjoy a thrilling adventure in the latest 3D anime art style.

games.name: Haunted Room! Urami-chan
games.summary: In this "life-intervention watching game," you control the earthbound spirit "Urami-chan." Travel between an apartment's past and present to change the murdered resident's future. The game unfolds in semi-real time, tasking you to watch over the resident and intervene.

games.name: Haunted by Femboy
games.summary: In this choice-based NSFW visual novel after inheriting a strange house from your parents, you stumble upon an ancient book and accidentally summon a mischievous femboy ghost. Now bound to your home, the ghost becomes your roommate, and it's up to you to find the missing pages of the book while navigating your unusual new life together.

games.name: Hayaku! Island of Darkness
games.summary: Explore a mysterious island full of dangers and uncover the secrets behind the anomalous creatures that inhabit it in this retro-style metroidvania.

games.name: He Who Watches
games.summary: Manipulate gravity, walk on walls, and use your magical arrow to solve mind-bending puzzles in this grid-based dungeon puzzler. Decipher secrets of the canvas and search for the mythos known as He Who Watches in this continuation of the Dungeon Crawler Jam 2022 winning entry.

games.name: Headlice
games.summary: Headlice is a reverse horror game where you play as an escaped biological abomination fleeing an inept corporation. Embrace your parasitic nature and become the monster you were meant to be.

games.name: Healthy Hero: Tower Defense
games.summary: Healthy Hero is a Tower Defense game with roguelike elements, where the player protects a hero from attacking junk food. You need to build and upgrade defensive towers to stop the enemies. The levels become increasingly challenging with new types of junk food and waves

games.name: Hear My Light
games.summary: A short narrative puzzle-shooter about bringing your brother home through a contaminated combat zone by guiding him with drones. He and the enemy are blind and catatonic, responding only to your drones' sounds — so every signal to shoot has to be your tactical decision. Especially when the dead rise

games.name: Heart Dungeon
games.summary: Heart Dungeon is a roguelite action game with visual novel elements that follows a boy called Leo who gets inside a video game that manifests elements of the psyche of whoever enters it. He will use this dimension to fight the illness that afflicts his mother and understand what is going on in his own heart.

games.name: Heart of Muriet
games.summary: Unique voxel fantasy real-time strategy. Experience the land of Muriet and reunite your family in this epic real-time strategy game! It's a game for people who love RTS games, but intense micromanagement stops them from playing.

games.name: HeartLinks: A Puzzle Called Love
games.summary: Solve puzzles with the power of friendship! Each student you befriend gives you a unique item that lets you unlock new areas and explore a wacky anime school! To deliver a confession to your crush, can you clear every obstacle? Can you overcome your feelings? Can you solve the puzzle called love?

games.name: Heartlines
games.summary: Heartlines: A choice-driven FPS. Under an angel's threat, you have 10 days to kill the demon hiding among 5 friends. Who is the victim? With 10+ endings, every choice leads to salvation or hell. Will you obey the light or find the truth?

games.name: Heartseers Grove
games.summary: Gather, craft, build, and explore in Heartseers Grove, a cosy survival game set in a peaceful world of forests, hills, and caves.

games.name: Hela: Of Mice & Magic
games.summary: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine.

games.name: Helenland
games.summary:
Helen finds a mysterious video game on her doorstep and starts playing it.
But as she progresses, strange events begin to happen around her...

Helenland is a single-player, first-person psychological horror.
The game features deep narrative, exploration and puzzles.

games.name: Hell Of War: Combined Arms
games.summary:
Hell Of War: Combined Arms is a tactical FPS/RTS hybrid set in modern combined-arms combat. Players observe the battlefield through a command drone, locate enemy forces, issue orders to infantry and armored vehicles, and call artillery and rocket support.

During battle, players can take direct control of an infantry commander, an armored vehicle, an FPV drone, or a drop drone. Missions focus on coordinating units, capturing control points, managing support resources, and using destructible buildings and vegetation to change the battlefield.

games.name: HellPunk: Purgatorium
games.summary: HellPunk is a 2D action gore roguelite game. You play as the main character Asher Drake, who must help Leviathan conquer the Tower and solve the mystery of his family's vanishing.

games.name: Hellfire Poncho
games.summary: Hellfire Poncho is a western rogue-lite isometric shooter. Shoot little demons with your upgraded weapons, die, and try again stronger. Bet your upgrades against the creatures you meet in the saloon, and develop your best build. Don't push your luck....

games.name: Hellforged
games.summary: Hellforged is a loot-driven, extraction bullet-heaven game. Fight through demon-infested maps, pre-craft your build, hunt powerful gear, and combine abilities into epic synergies. Every run is a tense heist. Safely extract epic gear mid-battle or risk it all for greater rewards!

games.name: Hello World: a developer story
games.summary: The developer narrates. The world evolves. The fourth wall breaks. Welcome to Hello World, a charming Narrative Physical Adventure where you play a game as it's being created live.

games.name: Hellwire
games.summary: A mathematical hell for 2-4 players where only the thrill matters — our law is ETERNAL GAMBLE. You're a DEMON among demons — play cards, gamble your mind, and smash faces. Luck won't save you.

games.name: Help me Cleaner Sama!: I Got Isekai'd to Clean Monster Girl Basements
games.summary:
This is a comedic fantasy puzzle game that follows an overworked cleaner transported to another world and tasked with clearing dangerous basements for a cast of eccentric monster girls. The story blends absurd humor and visual novel-style dialogue with satire about work, responsibility, and everyday frustrations.

Gameplay focuses on grid-based, turn-based puzzles where players manage limited movement, avoid hazards, and solve stage-specific challenges that vary by character. The game also includes mature themes, unlockable animated scenes, and a gallery mode.

games.name: Herb Seek Slash
games.summary: Herbs Seek Slash is a 2D top-down scrolling shoot'em up game with fantasy background. An ordinary swordsman, Ethan, sets out to find an ordinary herb to save his sister, Elaine, on an extraordinary and perilous journey.

games.name: Here Again
games.summary: You wake up in a silent underground facility with one simple instruction: REMEMBER THE BUTTON. Weird dreams and changing surroundings haunt this place. Explore, observe, and unveil the mystery that envelopes this place in this Retro Psychological Horror Game.

games.name: Hermit Computer
games.summary: Hermit Computer is a horror-puzzle game set in 2001. Deep within the Hermit Kingdom, you play as an outsider tasked with extracting critical intelligence using a secretive state-controlled computer operating system.

games.name: Hero Chest
games.summary: The perfect combination of Roguelike, Hack Slash and Card Game! In Hero Chest you are an angry chest that got tired of being looted and decided to finish them all! With powers and special cards create the dungeon and strategize to reach your goal. An adventure full of combat and gold!

games.name: Hero's Hand
games.summary: Embark on the ultimate Poker-Based Roguelike RPG Adventure! Hero’s Hand packs a strategic punch! Become the Knight of Spades & save the land of Cardunia! The game features hand drawn animation, humorous fantasy monsters, & addictive turn-based poker combat that keeps you coming back for more!

games.name: Heroic Musical Chairs
games.summary: Battle friends and family in an heroic, high-stakes game of musical chairs ! On your couch or online, with easy-to-handle controls, play cartoonish sports wizards in dozens of wacky and merciless arenas. Fight and race with bravery, player, and you shall become the true ruler of the one chair.

games.name: HexLands
games.summary: HexLands is a turn-based, roguelike city builder set on procedural medieval islands. Grow your empire and adapt to harsh environments! Customize your deck, manage your resources, complete quests, and synergize perks! How far will your empire reach?

games.name: Hexistence
games.summary: Hexistence is a Tower Defense Roguelike Deck Builder based on four universal elements: Matter, Energy, Space & Time. Place powerful towers and play wondrous spells to defend the Hexspire from the waves of Ethereals sent by the Ether...

games.name: Hexiv
games.summary: Hexiv is a strategy deckbuilder about surviving on a lush but hostile planet. Use cards to build, explore and expand while battling a determined adversary to unlock the mysteries of this genre-blending roguelike!

games.name: Hexrite
games.summary: You are a sorcerer part of a group of mysterious characters embarking on an adventure to fulfil an ancient magical ritual. Fight, quest and explore in this stylized action-adventure indie title!

games.name: High Rollers: Dice Drop Duel
games.summary: Challenge your friends to high stakes arcade puzzle action in High Rollers: Dice Drop Duel! There's something for all types of players with a variety of solo, multiplayer and online modes.

games.name: Hips N Noses
games.summary: HIPS N' NOSES is a café management simulation! In a sleepless world, Mela is the only one who dreams. She runs a café that restores lost memories. Serve guests by day, battle in nightmares by night to collect the memory flower, customize your café, and become the most renowned owner!

games.name: HiroBot: Clean & Restore
games.summary: HiroBot: Clean & Restore is a relaxing single-player game you can enjoy at your own pace. Clean up dirt, dispose of trash, and restore objects. Reach every nook and cranny with your jetpack, and experience the satisfaction of bringing grimy areas back to life!

games.name: Hirotonfa's American Revolution Smuggler
games.summary: A historical trading and dating sim set during the American Revolution. Manage a trade ship hauling goods between colonial ports, profit from volatile daily market swings, and navigate faction dangers, from militias to pirates, while choosing sides that affect regional quests. Along the way, romance charming colonial “state-chans” across territories like Louisiana and Quebec, blending economic strategy, risk-filled navigation, and character-driven narrative.

games.name: HitTube
games.summary: Top-Down arcade where you're a vlogger — Travel around the world, make streams of how you destroy everything around and play dozens of minigames!

games.name: Hitoriasobi
games.summary: Cute and a little strange? "Hitori Asobi" is a deck-building roguelike x 3D board game. "This is a game where you ■■ the people you hate!" Surrounded by lots of wonderful things, Rinachi, a very happy girl, decides to play a special game devised by her dear friend Poco...

games.name: Hoa 2
games.summary: Hoa 2 opens a long, long time after Hoa closed with its emotionally charged ending, leaving fans wondering what happened to the namesake little fairy. The cycle of life brings her back to a homeland reshaped by time, and her old friends have long since passed. Alone in a world both familiar and changed, Hoa must find new purpose in this gentle and heartfelt tale of change, of letting go and moving forward.

games.name: Hollow Drive
games.summary: In that world, simply being alive was enough to bear the weight of sin. To prevent the depletion of energy that grants supernatural powers, those who fail to prove their "worth of existence" are eliminated. …In this desolate world, I awoke with no memories, not even knowing my own name.

games.name: Hollow Home
games.summary: Hollow Home is an isometric narrative RPG about the russian invasion of Ukraine, told from the perspective of a teenager trapped inside an occupied city. Learn survival skills, build relationships and face tough choices as each passing day brings new tragedies and destruction to your childhood home.

games.name: Hollow Stories: Lockdown
games.summary: A neo-retro survival horror noir game where you explore, solve puzzles, and fight to survive in a city ruled by corruption and cults.

games.name: Hollowed Oath
games.summary: Hollowed Oath is a fantasy MMORPG set in the beautiful yet fractured world of Orrathis. Players assume the role of an Oathsworn, choosing three classes to define their own path customizing each ability they choose. Adventure, explore, collect, craft, and battle to uncover the truth behind your Oath.

games.name: Hollywood Animal
games.summary: Make your dreams come true — or crush someone else’s. Take the helm of a major Hollywood studio at the dawn of sound cinema, and guide it through decades of creative achievements and glamor, debauchery and dark deeds, tough choices and unpleasant compromises.

games.name: Hoozuki no Yakusai
games.summary: Hoozuki no Yakusai is a compact horror-leaning visual novel set in a rural town haunted by an old superstition linked to the hoozuki (Chinese lantern plant). You follow a protagonist drawn into a string of strange incidents and escalating misfortunes as local secrets, folklore, and interpersonal tensions unravel.

games.name: Hop & Seek
games.summary: Hop & Seek is a multiplayer egg hunt game set in a game show for Easter bunnies. You can hide eggs, seek eggs and trick your friends.

games.name: Hope Timbre
games.summary: Guide a mysterious creature through imaginary realm at night, or help two siblings awaken their broken world during the day. In dreams, you traverse the colorful environments and solve puzzles to find various hope instruments. Later, use them to summon the spring and escape the never-ending cycle.

games.name: Hoptale
games.summary: 《Hoptale》 is a casual and strategic Rougelite game that combines slot machines with combat. Players will use the slot machine to determine the character's next behavior, the damage caused to monsters, and the loot obtained!

games.name: Hordestomp
games.summary: A third person survivors like with aiming and shooting. Mow down up to 10,000 enemies on screen at once!

games.name: Horror Scenarios: The Redwood Estate
games.summary: Investigate the Redwood Estate as officers Tim Rieff and Kim Hansbury in this classic top-down survival horror game. Face terrifying creatures, manage scarce resources, and uncover the dark secrets behind the mysterious events that took place within the estate.

games.name: Horus: Desert Survivor
games.summary: Survive the sands of mythological Egypt in Horus: Desert Survivor, a survivor-like action game with deckbuilding. Build divine weapons, fight corrupted gods and mythical beasts, cleanse the fallen, and unleash godlike power.

games.name: Hostyle
games.summary: Hostyle follows agent Cryptic's job interview to become an assassin for the most corrupt company on earth. This fast-paced 3D platformer combines stylish movement options alongside a futuristic but nostalgic Y2K aesthetic.

games.name: Hours After Midnight
games.summary: Dive deep into a roguelike survival quest against Rettam'diov, the Consumer of Worlds. Progress, earn experience, refine characters, and uncover potent tools. Face relentless hordes alone or amplify the thrill, teaming up cross-platform in our distinctive co-op mode.

games.name: House 2
games.summary:
As a terrible storm approaches, two young girls spend a fateful night watching TV and playing games…

House 2 is the sequel to the hit indie horror game, House. In House 2, you play as Tabby & Melody, finally free from their cursed home, in the next chapter of the House saga.

games.name: Hug Factory
games.summary: An incremental/management game about hugging people to generate profits and the neverending pain of inflation.

games.name: Human Planet
games.summary: 500,000 years ago in the Stone Age, explore uncharted lands in search of a settlement. Survive hunger and predators armed with only crude weapons and your wits.

games.name: Human: Profit
games.summary: An accurate depiction of our world, baked into a short, classic incremental game. Take over Grandpa's farm, rebuild the town, and do whatever it takes to succeed. Also rabbits.

games.name: Humanity Echo: Cyberpunk Tactical RPG
games.summary:
Humanity Echo is a tactical turn-based RPG set in the rusted harbour slums of Odesa, 2044.

You play as an Engineer - not a soldier - using sabotage, environmental manipulation, and raw intellect to outsmart a corporate machine. In this high-tech, low-life world, every explosion carries physical weight and every shot leaves a unique acoustic imprint.

games.name: Hunting Simulator 3
games.summary: This open-world game lets you experience the thrill of the hunt, with your faithful dog or fellow hunters by your side! Choose your equipment from official brands, and explore the wilderness in search of your next game.

games.name: Hydraulic Slam
games.summary: In this turn-based, tactical tennis simulation you build, control and improve your own tennis robot. Play on grass, clay and hard courts and balance your energy, precision and condition throughout the match. Maintain and develop your robot between matches.

games.name: Hyper Bun Buster: Rocket Hammer Action
games.summary: Hyper Bun Buster: Rocket Hammer Action is a top-down bump combat action game where you control Tess, a bunny girl who uses her huge hammer to send enemies flying into other enemies!

games.name: Hyper Drill
games.summary: Hyper Drill is a speedrunning runner game, where you fly at supersonic speed and destroy everything in your path. Drill through any obstacle, jump between different galaxies, and uncover the mysteries of the universe.

games.name: HyperFatal
games.summary: AIR STRAFE, ROCKET JUMP, and SURF your way through dimensions in this HYPER-intensive skill-based movement shooter of old. The onslaught of foes in your way are invading worlds, and the only way to stop them is to show you will be FATAL.

games.name: HyperTyper 2000
games.summary: Type, dodge, parry, and survive in HyperTyper 2000! A hybrid typing/bullet hell game where both halves of the action are nonstop! Test your typing skills with one hand and dodge with the other.

games.name: Hyperfight 2
games.summary: The next evolution of HYPERFIGHT! The fast-paced, no-block fighter returns with fresh knockout mechanics and a colorful cast of new and returning characters.

games.name: Hyperflex Ultra
games.summary: Dodge obstacles, switch gravity in ways you never even thought possible and see just how hard you can FLEX in this endless action platformer. Think you've got what it takes to master all four levels and achieve the VIBE?

games.name: Hyperlane Highway
games.summary:
Hyperlane Highway is a VR roguelike arcade shooter where your body is the controller. You physically lean to surf a hoverboard through neon faster-than-light transit tunnels. No thumbstick needed, no motion sickness, nothing between your intention and the lane. Kill enemies, build combo, go faster. Die, come back stronger.

You are a Way Rider: a sponsored celebrity operative clearing rogue AI constructs from the galaxy's collapsed FTL network. Every run is a live broadcast. Every death is a media event. Between runs you spend Sponsorship Credits on permanent upgrades in your Ship Hub, ensuring the next ride starts stronger.

Strategic depth comes from a deep roguelike build system. Dual-wield energy weapons and shape each run using 40+ randomised Sponsor Mod cards, stacking synergies like chain lightning, explosive rounds and shield reflection. Mid-run slow-motion Pitstops let you buy, sell or recycle upgrades via rival corporate faction vendors before re-entering the chaos. Killing enemies builds a heat combo that physically increases your travel speed. Skill directly controls pace, rewarding aggression without punishing casual play.

games.name: Hypnostasis
games.summary: A survival horror game about psychological trauma. You wake up from your room to an unsettling world of disturbing creatures. The world you know has warped into something sinister. Navigate nightmarish worlds, uncover buried memories, and confront the shadows. Will you find the path to salvation?

games.name: I Am Night
games.summary: A folk horror roguelike deckbuilder where you tear apart and scrap together cards to face monsters, unravel mysteries, and survive a world forged in fear. Set out on a brave, twisted adventure of self-discovery.

games.name: I Can Offer You Flowers
games.summary: A cosy puzzle and bouquet game, which will appeal to all fans of problem solving in a cosy and aesthetic universe. As a florist, you carefully select the flowers that match the requests... and explore the many emotional combos to touch people in your own way!

games.name: I Chew, Therefore I Am
games.summary: A narrative-centric game dedicated to overthinkers. A whimsical cosmic road trip to find your cow, and deal with the thoughts you can't stop chewing on.

games.name: I Never Late for Work
games.summary: This is a life-simulation roguelike card game. Harness item and skill cards to shorten your commute, continuously boost yourself through diverse events, forge connections with different friends to help each other out, and become the best employee who never arrives late.

games.name: I Saw a Flying Saucer
games.summary: An interactive fiction about a man who lost his wife and goes in search of a UFO that shouldn't exist.

games.name: ICU: Intensive Care Unit 8
games.summary: ICU – Intensive Care Unit 8 is a single-player horror game where you’re trapped in a looping hospital corridor and must spot anomalies to find a way out.

games.name: Icarus-Bolt
games.summary: Icarus-Bolt is a single-player open-world platformer set in on an off world mining colony, where something has gone terribly wrong.

games.name: Ice on the Edge
games.summary: ICE on the EDGE is a figure skating simulation game where you train athletes and lead them to victory. Plan training, master techniques, and refine routines for competitions. Face fierce rivals, push the limits, and carve your legacy on the ice. Guide your skater to the ultimate stage—On the Edge.

games.name: Ichorous Moon
games.summary: Run! Race through the corrupted streets of Türme to stop the rising of the Ichorous Moon

games.name: Icy Tower
games.summary: The legendary jumping game is back! Join Harold the Homeboy and friends as they jump up the Icy Tower. Make combo jumps to build up massive scores. How high can you get?

games.name: Idle Chibi Knight
games.summary: Chibi Knight returns in an idle dungeon crawler! Fighting and exploration happen automatically while you cast spells, acquire loot, unlock new skills, level up your attributes, and push deeper. Replay as multiple classes in this casual, incremental RPG.

games.name: Idle Garden
games.summary: This little garden quietly grows at the bottom of your desktop. With a bit of patience and care, it brings you more delightful plants and decorations. Arrange your desk garden with love, and let it be your gentlest companion through work and rest alike.

games.name: Idle Monkey Theorem
games.summary: **Idle Monkey Theorem** is a charming idle/clicker game that brings the famous *Infinite Monkey Theorem* to life. Watch as your adorable team of monkeys frantically type away on their typewriters, randomly producing words that against all odds slowly but surely recreate the complete works of William Shakespeare.

games.name: Idle Pixel Battle
games.summary: Idle Pixel Battle is a fantasy idle auto battler focused on loot, upgrades, and constant progression. Build a team of heroes and watch them fight automatically through waves of monsters.

games.name: Idle of the Dead
games.summary: A pixel-art idle zombie RPG that lives in a slim strip above your taskbar. Your survivors fight the horde while you work: loot scrap, forge gear, unlock skills, prestige and push through 4 difficulties. Minimize the apocalypse - or go fullscreen when the boss arrives.

games.name: Ikuma: The Frozen Compass
games.summary: Embark on a haunting journey into the cold in this narrative adventure - either alone or with a friend. IKUMA tells the story of Sam, a teenage boy who finds himself stranded in the Arctic with his dog. He must face not only its harsh environment, but also something lurking deeper in the shadows.

games.name: Illusive Domain
games.summary: Deflect, parry, and defeat your opponents through intense boss rush action. Fight for you and your allies’ freedom, lest you remain entombed forever more.

games.name: Imitation
games.summary: A choice-driven adventure where you play as a young girl in a world where immortality is the norm. In this world, immortal humans are referred to as "Players." Your choices affect Stress and Affinity. Through multiple playthroughs, get closer to the hidden truths and endings.

games.name: Immortal Boy
games.summary: A 2.5D turn-based RPG where you dodge through enemy turns - and emotional abuse.

games.name: Imperial Bureaucracy Hero
