And if that's not enough, and you want to prove the world, you are the best, then the competitive multiplayer mode, with an elo ranking system awaits you.

games.name: Time Jump
games.summary:
A casual 3rd person action-adventure

Play as William Roger in this 3rd person comedy adventure. It's 1994. You're late for school! No sleep. No Breakfast. You "accidentally" activate your professors “Camera” and get sucked into the past.

Lost and alone in this strange place with your wits and no knowledge of where to go next, uncover the many mysteries of why you are here and at all costs, find your way back home before time runs out.

games.name: Time to Die
games.summary: Time To Die is a strategic roguelike dice-builder. Choose your heroes to fight relentless enemies in turn-based combat where time is your enemy.

games.name: Timeless Heart VR
games.summary: Timeless heart VR is an action VR roguelike game, As the second work of Timeless Stories series, this work further simplifies and enriches the unique sword skill system of the series. Advancing in the unknown labyrinth with Lycanea, and break through this blockade from fate!

games.name: Tinker's Ascent
games.summary: Jump to new heights in Tinkers Ascent, a 3D platformer adventure game. Collect, craft, and rebuild in this world of floating islands. The biggest thing to remember: don't look down... or maybe just don't fall down.

games.name: Tiny Eden
games.summary: Tiny Eden is a peaceful first-person farming sim in the heart of a futuristic city. Turn your small apartment into a thriving smart garden. Grow plants, cook meals, sell your harvest, and expand your urban farm - from a single windowsill all the way to a rooftop paradise.

games.name: Tiny Flock
games.summary: From the creators of Human Fall Flat – Tiny Flock, a cosy, physics-based VR puzzle game for all ages. Help guide your adorable wayward sheep through beautiful hand-crafted diorama puzzles using the environment around you to get them to safety!

games.name: Tiny Fortress
games.summary: A short incremental game about defending your tiny fortress from hordes of tiny mobs. Place towers, gain resources by defeating enemies, and unlock new upgrades in the skill tree to strengthen your goblin stronghold.

games.name: Tiny House Finds
games.summary: Search inside and around cozy 3D houses, floor by floor, in a relaxing 3D hidden object game full of tiny details.

games.name: Tiny Shop
games.summary: Leave the hustle and bustle behind and bring your dream of a cozy little shop to life! Create, decorate, and watch visitors fall in love. Let your imagination run wild and craft a beautiful, inviting space they'll want to return to again and again.

games.name: Tiny Tree Talk
games.summary: Find a new sense of belonging on TinyTreeTalk – a wholesome old-school bonsai forum. Decorate miniature scenes, grow & shape bonsai trees, and bring people's diorama requests to life as you grow your reputation, unlock new props, and embark on a chill and vibey journey across mid-2000s Japan.

games.name: To Be Connected
games.summary: To Be Connected is a relaxing, minimalist strategy game where you shape the land, connect your sites, and maintain a balanced, harmonious landscape. Build a world that expands forever, or craft real-country layouts by shaping land and connecting important locations.

games.name: To Kill a God
games.summary: An immersive action roguelite experience with a groundbreaking skill system that allows you to craft your own skill tree. unlock the true potential of your character, delivering an ever-evolving experience.

games.name: To the Grave: The Battle for Faenora
games.summary: Delve into the captivating realm of Faenora in our upcoming real-time strategy RPG game, To the Grave: The Battle for Faenora. Drawing inspiration from timeless classics like Final Fantasy Tactics and Ogre Battle, we're modernizing the elements that made these games unforgettable.

games.name: ToMyX
games.summary: ToMyX is a narrative arcade action game that blends Visual Novel storytelling with fast-paced action, puzzles and emotional confrontations. Inspired by the developer's real past relationships, players must survive a surreal TV game show where memories become gameplay and every chapter ends with a Final Judgment.

games.name: Tokatonton: One-Armed Blacksmith
games.summary: Tokatonton: One-Armed Blacksmith is a medieval forge management sim. Craft unique weapons, satisfy demanding customers, or take risky deals for profit. Rebuild a crumbling forge with two struggling blacksmiths.

games.name: Tokens
games.summary: A deckbuilder roguelike that flips the rules with double-sided tokens. Line them up to trigger powerful Harmonies, forge synergies with Arcanes and Effigies, and face Mister Mirage’s exciting challenges.

games.name: Tokyo Ramen Drifter
games.summary: A driving roguelite inspired by Japan's 90s street racing scene. Deliver ramen, upgrade your car, and challenge rivals on mountain roads across Japan.

games.name: Tom the Postgirl
games.summary: Take a ride with Tom through her village and discover a great deal—perhaps too much—about the locals. Her approach, although controversial, is highly effective: intense and obsessive stalking.

games.name: TomaDo!
games.summary: TomaDO! is a fast, quirky multiplayer platformer where tomato heroes race through floating obstacle courses, dodge hazards, and respawn at checkpoints. Jump, dash, and explore golf and other modes to reach the finish first.

games.name: Tome Improvement
games.summary: A co-op dungeon crawler where you and your friends name the spells. Catch critters, combine them in your staff, and hope your friends remember which spell is "DIVORCE BEAM" when you are surrounded by skeletons.

games.name: Too Deep To Quit
games.summary: Grab your gear and your friends for a hilarious, golden-age co-op adventure! Dive into cursed temples, hunt for the ultimate treasure, and work together to stay alive. Beware of everything and everyone... after all, only the survivors get to split the gold!

games.name: Torizon Telecom
games.summary: Torizon Telecom is a text-based FPS game set in a vast world composed entirely of text. “Telecom”—a world where everything is text. “Telecom”... But does any other world exist beyond “Telecom”...? Or is “Telecom” the only one that exists...?

games.name: Total World Liberation
games.summary: Open World Survival Automation Crafting Building Turn-Based game, yup that's a huge mix of genres and it works!

games.name: Touhou Dream Duel
games.summary: Battle your way through Gensokyo in this fan-work inspired by classic Touhou Project fighting games.

games.name: Touhou Sousenkyou: Land of Oracular Zeitgeist
games.summary:
An extraordinary new entry to the world of Touhou shmup fangames is arriving in 2026!

With the sudden announcement of a "popularity contest" occuring in the Human Village, a variety of maidens—from familiar faces like Reimu Hakurei and Marisa Kirisame to completely new and original characters never seen before—set off to win the contest by battling it out.

But lurking in the shadows behind the curtains of this "popularity royale" lies a mastermind attempting to fix the matches...

A Phantasmagoria-styled versus game, sure to draw in allies, spectators, and even fairies!

games.name: Tower Deckfense
games.summary: Tower Deckfense is an exciting blend of tower defense and deck building. Build your deck strategically, upgrade your towers, and equip them with powerful modifiers to discover the best combinations and devastate your enemies.

games.name: Tower Tactics 2
games.summary: The fusion of deck-building roguelike and tower defense returns, bigger than ever! Build your deck with powerful new cards, unlock unique trinkets, and deploy enhanced towers to overcome relentless waves of enemies and new strategic challenges.

games.name: Tower of Tears
games.summary: A 3D Survival-Horror Metroidvania in a vast, interconnected tower ruled by cryptic systems, strange residents and esoteric mysteries...

games.name: Towerlings
games.summary: Watch autonomous adventurers climb a 100-floor tower while you guide their fate through strategic intervention. No direct control — only decisions. Choose when to summon, strengthen, or protect, and decide whether to build an army or raise a few elite heroes.

games.name: Townseek
games.summary:
Townseek is a relaxing exploration-trading game where you embark on a journey across the world of Explora and discover the lost legacy of Sir Reginald Sharkingston! Discover exotic landmarks, trade with faraway towns, fish, mine, and farm as you complete your journal and make a name for yourself!

The whole world is your sea now, so be sure to see all that it has to offer!

games.name: Toxic Crusaders
games.summary: The Toxic Crusaders return for an all-new, all-action beat 'em up for one to four players! Grab your mop, tutu and attitude, and get ready to clean up the mean streets of Tromaville, one radioactive goon at a time!

games.name: Toxoplasma
games.summary: You are trapped on an abandoned space station, developing a bio-weapon that makes the infected hallucinate demonic entities. Spot any anomalous signs of infection before they kill you, complete your research, and unmask the conspiracy that brought you here.

games.name: Toymaker: Threads of Joy
games.summary: Toymaker is a toy-crafting and store management simulator set in the 1910s Spain. Meet unique customers and colorful locals in a bustling city, and discover a magical story based on a folk legend. Follow two different mythic paths, and change the future of your hometown!

games.name: Trade Anchor
games.summary: Amidst powerful alien empires, you are among the first humans in this corner of the procedurally generated galaxy. Trade and explore. With no combat, your success hinges on mastering complex alien economies and navigating intricate politics. Can you carve out a place for humanity in the cosmos?

games.name: Trade Tales
games.summary: A cozy farming simulation meets entrepreneurial adventures. Create your legacy, Immerse yourself in a world of creativity, social interactions, and unexpected twists. Shape your story, build your own brand, and discover the joy of life in "Trade Tales." Your adventure begins now

games.name: TrailRail
games.summary: Your path taken is the key. "TrailRail" is a physics-based action puzzle game where the trajectory of your movement becomes a tangible object. Control the girl and aim to escape from the mysterious research facility.

games.name: Train Goes Right
games.summary: A cozy physics based railroad simulator where you chop trees, drive trains, transport materials, and build track one rail at a time in the early steam age. The goal is simple: go right.

games.name: Train Set Code
games.summary: Build a train set layout where everything runs on its own. Automate points and signals to direct the trains and keep them moving. Get creative and design a huge network that carries a fleet of trains.

games.name: Train World Driver
games.summary: Take the Driver’s Seat in Train World Driver! Control iconic locomotives from steam engines, diesel beasts, and modern high-speed marvels in this casual, fun game. Complete missions, deliver passengers or cargo and explore stunning environments.

games.name: Trainwatch
games.summary: Meet Troy, the new Gatekeeper. His job is simple - close the gates at a desolate railway crossing for one month. This is his last chance to earn back his wife's trust. To prove he can stay sober. To become a better man. Join him at the Tower in the middle of nowhere. Help Troy fix his life.

games.name: Transport Fever 3
games.summary: Transport Fever 3, the ultimate transport tycoon returns, bigger, deeper, and more dynamic than ever. Build the routes that transform the world across land, sea, and sky using over a century of evolving transport options. Design and build your ideal transport network.

games.name: Trapped on the FlipSide
games.summary: In this Puzzle Platformer, follow the narrative of three explorers, kidnapped by a mechanical megastructure. Play as their assistant spherical robot in an effort to save them from this brutal place. By powering up the system, area by area, the secretive past and dark truth may make itself known.

games.name: Trash Day
games.summary: Team up with your raccoon squad in this physics-based co-op adventure. Scavenge trash, fill your stolen shopping cart, and work together to get back home. Live your best raccoon life.

games.name: Trash Wars
games.summary: A 3D hybrid tower defense game! Defend against trash, send trash. Manage resources, build turrets, automate defenses, and survive against pollution.

games.name: Travelling Light
games.summary: Travelling Light is a narrative game about four friends, Lars, Leah, Samson, and Ivy, caught in the turbulence of their early thirties. Inspired by real events, this experience lets you step into each perspective as love, friendship, and heartbreak collide.

games.name: Treasure Islands
games.summary: Help Nick and Pippa find a selection of new artefacts and exhibits for the Grand Museum in an exciting adventure across a number of islands, each with their own quirks, characters and strange events!

games.name: Treasure Rush: Phantom Infiltration
games.summary:
After you save your friends from the Tower Cave, things in Chairwood don’t calm down at all. People start going missing, whole houses turning quiet overnight, and nobody knows what’s going on. Every clue you follow keeps pointing back to Phantom Corp. They’re acting like nothing’s happening, but everyone knows they’re involved.

So now it’s up to you and your friends to go inside their facility, figure out what they’re doing, and stop it before the whole town ends up gone.

games.name: TreasureTails
games.summary: A cozy, relaxing and casual adventure game where you play as a curious cat searching for treasures. Explore peaceful landscapes, follow treasure maps and solve clues to find and unearth many hidden wonders and mysteries.

games.name: Trees Hate You
games.summary: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...

games.name: Trial By Magic
games.summary: There comes a time for every spell caster when they must face the TRIAL BY MAGIC. Those who overcome the challenge are forever known as Wizards, a title carried with pride. Those who fail are branded Wimps, forever shamed. So the question to you, spell caster, is: ARE YOU A WIZARD OR A WIMP?

games.name: Triarchy
games.summary: Sail your ship, explore islands, fight monsters, choose your abilities, and craft legendary gear to hunt for deadly bosses. Play Triarchy your way! Activate Boss Challenge Modes or enable Assists to suit your playstyle. Open-world, Co-op, Action Adventure (1-3 Players)

games.name: Trick Eight
games.summary: On a remote village shrouded in bloody tradition, a centuries-old ritual endures. You are a detective with unique skills, yet branded as a traitor. Will you surrender your limbs to ascend like an immortal? Or risk everything at the edge of science and plunge into the abyss of truth?

games.name: Trickshotterz
games.summary: SCORE IN THE TOP OF THE CUP. Pick abilities, grab wild powerups, and pull off absurd trickshots that hit harder the crazier they are. Play with up to 4 players locally, online, or hop into public matchmaking.

games.name: Trifoil
games.summary: Trifoil is a minimalist, cerebral line drawing puzzle game, that explores how lines can interact with themselves. It has multiple puzzle mechanics, secrets to discover and mysteries to solve.

games.name: Trigonometric Equations
games.summary: Trigonometric Equations is a strict side-scrolling rhythm game. Solve the trigonometric equations to fly through fleeting points and curves perfectly!

games.name: Trip Movie /Mosaic: Shounen Alice Satsujin Jiken
Trivia Murder Party 3
games.summary: Your favorite trivia-obsessed serial killer is heading to summer camp to put you through a sinister new set of minigames and murder. Take a stab at answering questions correctly, engage in luck and skill-based activities, and sabotage your fellow campers in order to survive the summer.

games.name: Trizna
games.summary: “Trizna” is a classic plot-driven 2.5D metroidvania filled with intense battles utilizing the unique features of weapons, evasions, parries, and counterattacks. Explore the mysterious and eerie realm deeply intertwined with pagan beliefs, with blade, magic and a keen mind.

games.name: Tropico 7
games.summary: Get rich or die trying! In Tropico 7, you step into El Presidente’s shiny boots again to build your island nation and – literally – move mountains. As glorious leader you guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity.

games.name: Trouble in Potion High
games.summary: Something has gone very wrong in Potion High. As an outside specialist for "hopeless cases," you must fight your way through corridors overrun by interdimensional creatures. Restore order using potions and your own pocket laboratory. Can you contain this chaos?

games.name: Trucker 2056
games.summary: Trucker 2056 is a narrative trading RPG featuring a point-and-click driven plot and card-based combat. Heavily inspired by late 80s and early 90s classics by Origin and MicroProse.

games.name: Truckful
games.summary: Drive your pickup truck through seemingly peaceful countryside valleys, deliver much-needed goods to local townsfolk and unravel the small town mystery. Beware, the old forest is watching.

games.name: True Confession
games.summary:
Dramatic and hardcore pixel art shooter that turns into crossroad of anger, gilt, religion and psychoanalysis

True Confession is a game aimed at fans of action movies 80-00 years (Heat, Training Day, The Wire, The Departured). In visual style resembles POSTAL, Crimsonland, GTA2. So it's oldschool but seasoned with modern mechanics and deep religious and psychological plot.

The game is hardcore, each opponent can pose a fatal threat and gives rise to a healthy sense of rivalry. True Confession is distinguished by its down-to-earthness, the game does not have automatic health regeneration and superpowers, an important distinctive mechanic of the game is "anger".

As the game aims to feel grounded, there are no rocket launchers, flamethrowers, or tanks — this game is about crime in the streets, not the battlefield.

Let's pray/play together!

games.name: True Nightmare: Diner Loop
games.summary: Immerse yourself in an atmospheric psychological horror with a haunting VHS aesthetic. As a new FBI agent, you become trapped in a looping anomaly inside a secluded roadside cafe. With every room you explore, the nightmare grows, and something relentlessly follows you. Can you escape?

games.name: Trypan
games.summary: TRYPAN - A survival horror experience centered on exploration, resourcefulness, and sheer will to survive. Investigate your father's disappearance in the abandoned town of Stagmon.

games.name: Tsurugihime
games.summary: Tsurugihime is a side-scrolling action RPG. The last battle is in 100 days. It is up to the player to decide how to live until the day. Battle, ikusei, exploration, story, and even sister. "Craft" everything. An RPG that "crafts" fate.

games.name: Tuoni
games.summary: A turn-based roguelite RPG set in a mythic northern wilderness. Explore procedurally generated lands, battle eerie folkloric creatures, and craft powerful builds on your journey to the land of the dead. Experiment with diverse playstyles in a richly tactical, old-school inspired adventure.

games.name: Turbo Loop
games.summary:
Turbo Loop is a casual slot car racing game built around simple gameplay that is easy to pick up, yet challenging to master. Whether you're chasing perfect lap times or battling head-to-head, every race is about precision, timing, and control.

Take on AI opponents, challenge a friend in local multiplayer, and push your skills across a wide variety of tracks. Unlock new cars, fine-tune their look, and create your own racing circuits with a simple and easy-to-use track editor.

games.name: Turning Manor
games.summary: All you have to do is count the differences and choose an exit. Easy right? Yet strange things start happening as soon as you sign the job contract… It's up to you to unravel the mysteries of Turning Manor.

games.name: Turok: Origins
games.summary: Play as the legendary Turok warriors to face off against ferocious dinosaurs and a terrifying alien threat that seeks to destroy all human life across the galaxy.

games.name: Twin Jet Racer
games.summary: Two jets. Two triggers. That’s all you need to swerve, drift, corkscrew, loop or even fly to reach the next checkpoint and top the leaderboard. Master the controls and the physics to progress to the next class of racer and unlock greater challenges. Compete against friends or against the clock.

games.name: Twinkle Seek
games.summary: Go search for sparkles to the ends of the world!

games.name: Two Dollar Suits
games.summary: Two Dollar Suits combines the very best of the Action-Strategy genre into a fast-moving criminal playground, where players thrive in creativity and exploration. Complete intricate levels and create your own paths using skill, ingenuity, and raw power.

games.name: TwwwT: The Witches Who Weave Timelines
games.summary: A 2D action-focused roguelite where you control “witches from history,” battling endless enemies and dense bullet-hell barrages to correct fractured timelines

games.name: Type & Magic
games.summary: Type words to shape your path, solve puzzles, and explore the ruins of a dead wizard's castle. Find artifacts to uncover the castle's dark mysteries. Report everything you saw to your master. Or… don't.

games.name: Type Ride
games.summary: "Type Ride" is a typing-based tower defense game where you summon units by typing. In a world overrun by ink lifeforms, the protagonist—once known as the "Type Rider" for her high-speed typing skills while riding a motorcycle—decides to ride her beloved bike once again to resolve the chaos.

games.name: Typeoids
games.summary:
Typeoids is a fast arcade-style typing game inspired by the classic Asteroids.
Wield your keyboard to protect yourself against the incoming asteroids threatening to crush your ship, and get performance statistics and track the progress in your typing journey.

games.name: Tyrants Must Fall
games.summary: Build your rebel army and lead them to victory over the Tyrant King in this turn-based tactical roguelike. Improve your leader's skills, unlock new units, and hone your battlefield strategy as you march towards your fate as the Hero of Destiny.

games.name: Tyrants Rafting
games.summary: Tyrants Rafting is a chaotic co-op escape game where two players control one rigged boat and race from checkpoint to checkpoint before the timer runs out. Play as infamous dictators on the run, survive deadly rivers, grab pickups, and stumble through a satirical escape full of golden speedboat boosts, pickup-truck shootouts, and friendship-ruining shared controls.

games.name: UN:Me
games.summary: UN:Me is an adventure game where you guide a girl harboring multiple souls within her body through an unsettling mental labyrinth, engaging in dialogue with each soul while making the harrowing choice of which to keep and which to erase in your escape attempt.

games.name: Ugomeku Note
games.summary: Welcome to the world of UGOMEKU NOTE (“Wriggling Note”). You—gentle, kind, and always wearing a lovely smile—have been chosen as a hero to embark on an adventure full of humor and heart. This is a handcrafted RPG made with RPG Maker MV. All graphics, music, and systems are being created by a solo developer.

games.name: Ultima Chess VR
games.summary: Ultima Chess VR – chess as you've never seen before! Battle on the chessboard in virtual reality, where every piece comes to life and engages in a fantasy duel!

games.name: Ultimate Chaos Gambling Battle
games.summary: Poker, mahjong, hanafuda, blackjack… Welcome to the ultimate “ULTIMATE CHAOS GAMBLING BATTLE” where every form of gambling has been thrown into a chaotic melting pot! Don’t just understand the rules—master the chaos, bet your entire fortune (ALL-IN), and seize victory!

games.name: Ultimate Lemon Basket
games.summary: Ultimate lemon basket is a platformer where you lose if you drop a lemon on the ground. Between you and the goal are ghosts, cows, snipers, acid rain, hopes, dreams and other things AS WELL!!

games.name: Ultra Mushroom
games.summary: Hey! Wanna rise to the top at a festival stall? "Ultra Mushroom" is a high-energy game where you run a mushroom stall at a three-day festival and see how much you can earn. Gather mushrooms in the mountains by day and sell them at night. The key? Rhythmic banter and Ultra Mushrooms that bring joy!

games.name: Umblight
games.summary: Umblight is an Inscryption-like card game adventure where you're trapped in a dark, machine-filled room that changes as you go. Build your deck of shadow and light cards, make new cards by combining them and play mind-bending synergies as you try to defeat your dungeon master!

games.name: Unchest
games.summary: A mouse-only management game with a bit of tower defense. Restock goods, trade with customers and craft gear for the nighttime—if the monsters reach your shop, they’ll plunder your hard-earned gold.

games.name: Uncursed
games.summary:
Uncursed is a co-op pirate adventure where you rescue lost souls, loot shiny treasures, items and uncover secrets so dark even your torch might quit. Survive deadly dungeons, face unpredictable weather, and the occasional chaos caused by your crewmates—all while gathering loot to buy a ship, buy cool gear, and maybe splurge on a new hat.

Your crew's goal is to buy and repair a ship to reach more distant waters and shed light on the threatening secret.

Explore the surrounding islands alone or in a team, collect valuable items and the souls attached to them. Every day you can take part in a new adventure in the procedurally generated dungeon, which rewards you with valuable treasures if you survive its terrifying creatures and cunning traps.

games.name: Undefeated: Genesis
games.summary: The ultimate superhero experience. Fly freely and unleash your awesome powers as you battle violent mutants to save an alien planet.

games.name: Under Heaven or Hell
games.summary:
You wake up in Hell with no memory of how you got there, and no clear way out.

To return home, you will have to survive the brutal politics of this realm and forge alliances with two dangerous devils and an enigmatic angel, each with their own secrets, and temptations that may pull you closer.

Will you escape with your soul intact, or will your path become forever tied to those who linger within the flames?

Your choices will shape your fate, and perhaps, the fate of Hell itself.

games.name: Undergone: Before
games.summary: Explore the story of Kale Vortex in a world where nature thrives — until every step begins to change it.

games.name: Underground Business
games.summary: Underground Business is a horror cooking game where you prepare orders for a rural town at a pizzeria kiosk. Take orders, cook pizza, investigate the suspicious pizzeria underground and run for your life in high-intensity chases!

games.name: Underground Security Inc
games.summary: Defend your dungeon against "heroes" in this rogue-lite base defense game. Assign minions, build traps, and mine ores. All in the name of becoming the most profitable dungeon!

games.name: Unearther
games.summary: Journey into different places and environments in search of resources and valuables. Make tools and equipments, survive the dangers and lurking monsters. Craft your way of living and discover the unknown world hidden in plain sight.

games.name: Unfated
games.summary: Unfated is a single-player 3D papercraft Strategy RPG where you play as Jo, a peasant turned revolutionary as she leads a scrappy group of rebels to fight the forces of fate and oppression in a turn-based journey across the land of Antedeluvia, seeking to end a century long conflict.

games.name: Unhost
games.summary: Unhost is an anomaly-detection psychological horror game. You play as a paranormal detective trapped in an abandoned hospital. During each night shift, you must monitor surveillance cameras, detect anomalies, and capture them using a remote-controlled robot. Stay alert - your attention to detail is your only advantage! Collect evidence, explore your surroundings, make contact with ghosts. Survive seven nights of horror and uncover the truth.

games.name: United Heist: Facility Zero
games.summary: Work together in separate locations, each filled with unique puzzles that only your partner can help solve. Every move depends on sharp communication through in-game voice chat. Can you crack the code and escape before time runs out?

games.name: Unmixable Syrup
games.summary: I wolf down a cold, lonely meal. Work's wearing me down, and money's shaky. The syrup I pour into my cold coffee never mixes, no matter how much I stir. So I figure I'll just wander around in my dreams.

games.name: Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature
games.summary: Be a stone Golem and try to save Nature with the help of an adorable Fox! Reconnect ancient sources of energy in environmental puzzles. Discover secrets from a lost civilization and save animals on an emotional quest in a cozy, colorful world.

games.name: Unravel Trigger: Cold War
games.summary: The sequel to Unravel Trigger: Prelude to War.

games.name: Unreal Engine The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
games.summary: A fan recreation of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time with updated graphics, made using the Unreal Engine.

games.name: Unseasonable Flowering
games.summary: "Unseasonable Flowering" is a first-person horror game set in Japan. After moving to a new home, the young protagonist, Mashiro, is met with eerie residents and inexplicable phenomena. Something "sprouting" everywhere quietly erodes her daily life.

games.name: Unwound
games.summary: Lose yourself in a surreal candyland adventure about transformation and escapism. Descend into a land of weirdos and forgotten memories as you assemble a new you from whatever you find.

games.name: Unyverse
games.summary: Unyverse is a sci-fi, action role-playing game (ARPG) created by Afrime Studios. Unyverse delivers an immersive, story-driven gameplay experience for single and co-op players enriched by a deep Afro-Futuristic aesthetic.

games.name: Uppercute
games.summary: Uppercute is a 3D action platformer where, with the help of your sister and the use of your runner skills, you’ll dive into people's minds, face challenging opponents and retrieve valuable information to solve the mystery of your brother's disappearance.

games.name: Usual June
games.summary: Hang out, fight monsters, and discover your town’s darkest secrets in Usual June, a third person action game about summer break and the end of the world.

games.name: UvsU: You vs. You
games.summary: Outsmart your past self in a battle of cause and effect. Explore an interconnected clay world, discover its hidden rules, and uncover the secrets it would rather keep buried.

games.name: V.E.D.A: The Awakening of Souls
games.summary: V.E.D.A is a Soulslike training game with weighty combat and exploration. The protagonist, awakened with no memory, undergoes combat training in a training simulator and uncovers hidden secrets. You too can enter the Soulslike genre. Don't hesitate.

games.name: VHS World '89
games.summary: A cozy first-person sorting sim set in a 1989 video rental store. All 3,360 VHS tapes have spilled across the floor — pick them up, read the covers, and shelve them by genre. No timers, no pressure: just the quiet satisfaction of putting every last cassette back in its place.

games.name: VICCP 2 Core
games.summary: The Very Important Central Control Panel is back. Keeping the mysterious atmosphere and with even more mysteries. Control the omnipotence remote, experiment, and find many endings. Brainstorming in retro sci-fi style / Puzzle / Quest / Point Click.

games.name: VISK
games.summary: Face your fears in VISK, an open-world online co-op horror game for 1-2 players. Escape from a strange village, uncover the dark secrets of this place and solve puzzles to discover new areas. But beware, deadly creatures are after you and your friend!

games.name: VPetlings
games.summary: Raise your own virtual pet right on your desktop. Choose your favorite, take care of your companion, play together, train for battle, and help them evolve! They will always be there, keeping you company while you work, play, or browse.

games.name: Valerie
games.summary: Follow Valerie on a charming 2D adventure where you'll jump, slide, bounce and boost your way through dense forests and dreamscapes using her bubble powers.

games.name: Valkyrie Iteration: Mecha Pilot Raising Pocket Simulator
games.summary: Step into the role of a technomaster in Valkyrie Iteration, a sci-fi visual novel. Train and guide Lana, a young pilot, and her sentient mech, the Valkyrie, as they prepare for high-stakes battles against otherworldly foes.

games.name: Valley of the Old Masters
games.summary: The World has been in the midst of the winds of change. As a wandering artist, you end up in a mystical valley on your journey. Do you find inspiration for your art there?

games.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Oaths and Ashes
games.summary: Two vampires — an ambitious Kindred and a wretched Thinblood. Their fates clash in this Visual Novel set in the World of Darkness, where your arsenal extends beyond just words — from political machinations to forbidden Alchemy. Claw your way to power and leave your bitemarks on Berlin's underworld.

games.name: Vampires Die
games.summary: Hired by the "Council" to take out a rogue coven, you must gather your clan and travel through the dark streets, graveyards, and crypts to battle for hierarchy against the deadliest of your own bloodline. Roll the dice in this "chill" turn-based board game, but remember, sometimes even Vampires Die!

games.name: Vanguard Tides
games.summary: Fight in massive-scale battles where armies paint the battlefield in their color. Captured territory affects both your health and your abilities. Level up your vanguard and your army, defend your castles, and survive the shifting tides of battle to claim ultimate victory!

games.name: Vaunted
games.summary: The score of a lifetime hangs in the balance – can three cut-throat criminals look past their differences to pull it off? A story of bullets, bravado, and brazen lies unfolds across a galaxy of treasure hunters and crime syndicates in this sci-fi tactical RPG.

games.name: Ved: Recure
games.summary: Ved: Recure is a fast-paced action roguelite where you play as an adult trapped in the 1000th game you bought but never played. You’ll wield fully customizable buff chains to face off against formidable foes and strategic builds to conquer this 1000th game and make your way back to reality.

games.name: Veil of Madness
games.summary: Veil of Madness is a Lovecraftian Deck Builder game that merges the strategic charm of a deck builder with the immersive experience of a first-person RPG genre. Unravel eldritch secrets, battle insanity, and shape your destiny in this chilling journey.

games.name: Veil of the Damned
games.summary: Beyond the veil of the damned, face danger and treasure. Master your skills to survive the labyrinth.

games.name: Veiled Shadows
games.summary: Live a month in a rural mountain town, build bonds, and hunt a mystery across two worlds. Manage your days, explore dungeons, and fight turn-based battles to recover what's been lost.

games.name: Veils of the Past
games.summary: A psychological mystery where every clue reshapes reality. Unravel the link between a vanished woman and your missing sister, only to discover four entirely different truths, each revealing a new world, a new enemy, and the price of remembering.

games.name: Veinrider
games.summary: Veinrider is a short incremental game about traversing alien caves and escaping a strange planet.

games.name: Vena
games.summary: Roguelike deckbuilder meets hex-tile city builder! Build a resource engine to survive the center’s rising demands. Place producers, converters, and combo-rich tiles. Roll dice to shop, pick perks, and chase wildly different builds every run.

games.name: Verdge
games.summary: Verdge is a dynamic speedrun plaformer, where the player can decide which content is generated.

games.name: Verismo
games.summary: A ghost and a carnival clown plot revenge on the man who ruined their lives. An operatic tragedy set in 1920s Sicily.

games.name: Veriventure
games.summary: Craft intricate levels from a variety of pieces to create traps, puzzles and combat. Play through the story, access online levels, or make and share your own in this 3D dungeon maker.

games.name: Veros Veros Veros
games.summary: Maybe a waitress simulator. Maybe an arcade game where you play as a waitress, but in reality, it doesn’t really matter.

games.name: Versalis
games.summary: A fast-paced, grid-based, card-flipping tactical CCG for up to 4 players! Archetypes and team Dynamics bring powerful abilities to move, defend, swap, or reorient cards. Capture the board and flip your way to victory!

games.name: Veyora
games.summary: Veyora is a medieval open-world RPG with elements of farming, survival, and adventure. In a vast, stylized world, you decide where to live and what to create – whether near a bustling town, in the lonely mountains, or by a peaceful lake. Each location offers its own resources, challenges, and opportunities.

games.name: Vice: Magic City Mayhem
games.summary: Vice: Magic City Mayhem is a retro action-adventure game where you fight, collect new items, and upgrade your character as you make your way through bustling nightclubs, scenic beaches, and raptor-infested yachts.

games.name: Vignettes: The Dream City
games.summary: Vignettes: The Dream City is a first-person surreal dream-crawler game featuring turn-based combat, knowledge-based gameplay, non-linear exploration, and souls-like progression. Your dreams are haunted by a strange city, and you feel supernaturally drawn to explore it. What will you find within?

games.name: Vikings Dynasty
games.summary: Embrace viking life and earn Valhalla’s blessing. Survive in the harsh norse environments and praise the Gods. Become a Jarl, control every aspect of your village and protect your community at all costs. Build and customize ships and explore the fjords in the unforgiving world of Vikings Dynasty.

games.name: Virtue and a Sledgehammer
games.summary: Go back to your hometown and tear it down with a sledgehammer in this narrative exploration game. Confront your past in a devastating story about feeling like you no longer belong in the place you grew up.

games.name: Virtueror: The Virtual Conqueror
games.summary: Virtueror is an RTS with 4x and RPG elements. Your mission is to conquer new worlds and to extend your domain over the whole galaxy. Build your base, command your units, gather resources, set up defenses and crush anyone challenging you. Have no mercy and the universe will be yours!

games.name: Vision Quench
games.summary: An online co-op dark fantasy looter shooter set in the underbelly of a consumer goods conglomerate mega dungeon. Within its halls you will fight ancient foes and modern horrors. Can you survive long enough to make it to the top?

games.name: Vitalis
games.summary: Vitalis is a TTRPG-inspired Roguelike and Dungeon Crawler where you try to escape an occult forest. Cast your die to move, fight, and flee. Scale your character, collect items, and weapons. Defeat the boss and leave the forest, or run away and bide your time.

games.name: Vocaless
games.summary: Vocaless is a unique platformer game with rhythm elements, you must perform all of your actions to the beat! Not only that, but everything in the game, from enemies to obstacles, follows the beat of the music.

games.name: Void Diver: Escape From the Abyss
games.summary: Manage 'Balusha' antique shop in an anomalous city. Command 'Divers' into the abyss to recover artifacts from city dungeons. Survive and escape alive in this high-quality pixel art extraction action RPG. Face bizarre threats alone or with friends.

games.name: Void Dungeon
games.summary: Void Dungeon brings you a 2D Action RPG with intense hack & slash combat, deep character options, and unyielding enemies, which you can face solo or with up to 4 friends. Oh, and quirky costumes. Because it’s better to look good when the void consumes you.

games.name: Void Inc
games.summary: You are the Head of Tech at Void Inc., a rapidly growing SaaS startup where every decision creates another problem. Plan your day, survive frantic technical minigames, manage unstable staff and infrastructure, and try to reach the company's targets before stress consumes you.

games.name: Void Protocol
games.summary: Void Protocol is a 3D ​​hardcore puzzle​​ game built on ​​Temporal Imprint​​. In an indie-crafted cyberpunk lab, freeze/rewind objects' states (position, activation, motion) to crack ​​impossible puzzles​​. Manipulate causality—every action sparks solutions or paradoxes.

games.name: Void Raid
games.summary: A cooperative space horror about raiding derelict ships: breach compartments, grab the loot, and make it back to your own vessel before the oxygen runs out — or before something lurking in the dark gets to you.

games.name: Void/Breaker
games.summary: VOID/BREAKER is an Adrenaline-Fueled Roguelite FPS. Fight relentless machines driven by a hostile AI. Escape an endless cycle. Craft infinite weapon variants with deep gun modding. Forge deadly synergies. Carve your way out through environmental destruction/BREAK THE SYSTEM /BREAK THE SEQUENCE /BREAK FREE

games.name: VoidWalker: Call of Insomnia
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the world of dreams and discover its secrets, enjoying every moment thanks to photorealistic graphics

games.name: Vossarium
games.summary: Escape a twisted facility where reality bends around you. Sneak past The Guardian, use a camera with a reality shifting lens to break the laws of physics, befriend strange entities lurking inside, and uncover the dark truth of Mira Voss's life.

games.name: Voxenvale
games.summary: Voxenvale is a cozy blocky online realm builder where players jump, build, decorate, and visit each other's cubic worlds.

games.name: Voxotron
games.summary: A psychedelic hyper-speed racer with no speed limit. Pilot a spaceship around a spinning cosmic cylinder. No brakes. Thread impossible patterns and find the hyperfocus your brain was built for. Short runs. Instant death. Easy to learn, with insane skill ceiling. Pure flow state.

games.name: Voyage Router
games.summary: Voyage Router is a "navigation-based roguelike" where you explore procedurally generated terrain guided by your map. Adapt your route as the environment and conditions change, and visit as many target points as possible.

games.name: Wanderburg
games.summary: Wanderburg is a minimalist open-world roguelike in an ecosystem of Castles on Wheels. Consume, grow bigger, upgrade your modules, and survive! Unlock new weapons, build your castle, and discover the procedurally generated map!

games.name: Wandering Cat
games.summary: Wandering Cat is a fantasy adventure game for all cat lovers. The game offers an immersive and fun experience, where players can take on the role of a brave and independent cat with a refined palate!

games.name: Wandering Wolf
games.summary: Survival-Action experience in a dead world destroyed by civil war. You have to complete your own story, fighting for survival with monsters and nature.

games.name: Wanderlust
games.summary: A sandbox sci-fi adventure without combat. You have reached your adulthood and in accordance with the Mars Quorum, you are offered a Wanderlust, a period of time where you are given the means to freely explore the galaxy, getting to know the Ruhe societies and also yourself.

games.name: Wanderstate
games.summary: You find yourself alone in a place that feels familiar… but not quite right. Wander aimlessly or with purpose, it won’t matter. Is there an end? Has anyone been here before you? Time feels slow. Or maybe it's frozen. Or maybe… you’re not meant to leave.

games.name: Wanted 3D: Dead or Alive
games.summary: Grab your bandolier and saddle up for Wanted 3D, a GZDoom-powered Spaghetti Western FPS! It's time to settle the score with your former gang and reclaim what is rightfully yours. Are you ready for the wildest showdown the Wild West has to offer?

games.name: Wanting Shock
games.summary: Owari and her 7 friends plan to solve an abandoned mystery, but quickly spirals into something sinister.

games.name: War Trigger
games.summary: Destroy, smash and blast your way to victory! Use advanced weapons and vehicles to dominate the battlefield.

games.name: Warbound
games.summary: A Rogue-like, Tower Defense Auto-Battler. Raise the dead, battle knights and wage war with fleets of advanced futuristic Drones as you battle across the eras in this strategic combat simulator. Upgrade your base, unlock new technology, destroy the enemy before they can level up.

games.name: Ward Off Evil
games.summary: Ward Off Evil is an open world strategy RPG set in an apocalyptic sword & sorcery world. Create your character, rally an army, and roam the wastes as you battle to avert, or bring about, the end of the Cycle.

games.name: Warfactory
games.summary: Warfactory fuses planet-scale automation with real-time strategy and lite 4X elements. Build sprawling factories, design modular robot armies, and lead thousands of units into battle. Conquer a galaxy with a supply chain — one conveyor belt at a time.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
games.summary: Obliterate heretics in the name of the Emperor in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2! Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun with more enemies, more weapons, and new ways to purge!

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine II
games.summary: The galaxy is in peril. Entire worlds are falling. The Imperium needs you. Embody the superhuman skill and brutality of a Space Marine, the greatest of the Emperor's warriors, with Clive Standen (Vikings, Taken) as the iconic Captain Titus. Unleash deadly abilities and an arsenal of devastating weaponry to obliterate the relentless Tyranid hordes. Hold at bay the horrors of the galaxy in epic battles on far-flung planets. Uncover dark secrets and drive back the everlasting night to prove your ultimate loyalty to humanity.

games.name: Warhammer Survivors
games.summary: Thrust into a universe of relentless war, become the embodiment of bullet hell in Warhammer Survivors, a fast-paced roguelite survivors game. Play as characters from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar universes, collect and evolve iconic weapons and destroy endless swarms of enemies.

games.name: Warota: I Live Next to The Demon King's Castle LOL
games.summary: 【Village-Building Action RPG】 Saved by a goddess, you arrive in a ruined world ruled by the Demon King. Gather resources, build your village, swap hats to change classes and give villagers their roles. But one night, the Idol Demon King holds a Live next door...and monsters come pouring in!?

games.name: Warp Marked
games.summary: Warp Marked is an incremental space exploration game. Explore a mysterious uncharted dimension, navigate around its dangers, learn its secrets, and return stronger with every launch!

games.name: Watamari Part2: A Fake Marriage?
games.summary: This is a yuri game where you as an angel of love must help guide the heroines. Do your best, little angel (you) and take care of your mistress's wellbeing!

games.name: Watch Eye
games.summary: Victoria just wanted to take a shortcut through the usual parking garage in order to get home... she just didn’t expect to find an untold danger there.

games.name: Watch Out For Goblins!
games.summary: Experience the joy of physics based goblins in their natural habitat! Run, jump, kick and flip your way through a delightful physics sandbox! Explore and collect Power Cogs to become Goblin Royalty! There's no saying what might happen, and no stopping the BIG GOBLIN ENERGY!

games.name: Water Me & You
games.summary: Water Me & You is a cozy two-player co-op adventure in which you play as a water droplet or a seed-like creature that can change states, on a quest to regenerate a world left behind by humans.

games.name: Watering The Plant Girl: Roots & Rehydrated
games.summary: An inflation-kink NSFW visual novel where a scientist named Enora experiences the best and worst week of her life with a cute plant girl. Tons of worldbuilding and sexual-yet-wholesome content!

games.name: We Build Below
games.summary: A roguelite, co-op factory builder that is set on an alien planet. You're part of an rag-tag mining team trying to get rich. Meet the daily quota to keep your mining permit and defend against dangerous parasites to stay alive.

games.name: We Were Here Tomorrow
games.summary: You and your partner are taken to a mysterious facility where communication and cooperation are your lifelines. This asymmetrical co-op adventure will have you uncover secrets that will shape the fate of Tomorrow…

games.name: Welcome, [Employee Name]
games.summary:
Welcome, [Employee Name] is a satirical Papers, Please-like game set in a space station control room. You will experience being an employee of a giant corporation (HonkyTonk inc.) that controls everything entering and leaving the space station, sometimes to the detriment of its occupants...
Discover their secrets, help the people trying to make a difference, or not... your choice!

Control and cross-reference: Open manuals, read instructions, compare documents, this is your job!

Multiple story paths: Truck drivers have hearts too, and it seems like the company you work for has some... issues...

Choices have consequences: You have the power to make a difference, or to keep your head low in this big corporation. What choices will you make?

games.name: Well Dweller
games.summary: Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom. Play as Glimmer- a tiny bird armed with a matchstick- who must burn the wicked queen to save his family.

games.name: Westlanders
games.summary: Forge your legacy in the Westlands. Survive and thrive in a Wild West open world. Alone or with friends, explore, fight, and build from your customizable wagon. Expand into bustling settlements, recruit allies, and forge a network to tame the wilderness and build your legacy.

games.name: What We Bring
games.summary: What We Bring is a cozy puzzle game about the objects that shape a life. Organize, sort, and pack through the years, choosing what items to carry forward. The items you keep shape the character’s future, influencing the path they take in a branching narrative story.

games.name: Whatever It Takes
games.summary: Whatever It Takes is a hardcore first-person Action RPG in a dark fantasy setting. As a fallen god, master elemental magic, absorb enemy powers, and engage in tactical duels. Use a harpoon for traversal and shape the Omnisphere’s fate through your choices. Reclaim your throne. Whatever it takes

games.name: Wheelie Bad
games.summary: Pilot a wheelchair together and prove you're the superior driver. In this chaotic game, every single crash is definitely your partner's fault. Adapt as the game constantly introduces and mixes new mechanics. Survive the madness, or drive solo to show you were the carry.

games.name: When I’m Not Drawing
games.summary: In this cozy life-simulation RPG, you play as a young woman who moves to a new city to pursue her dream of becoming an artist. Manage your schedule, balance life and career, explore the city, and meet new friends. Live a fulfilling year on your own, at your own pace.

games.name: When Voices Died
games.summary: When Voices Died is a game of puzzles and silent emotions. Amid distant echoes and broken memories, you rebuild paths that reveal forgotten feelings — and the weight of choices that still echo.

games.name: Where Dolls Hang
games.summary: Where Dolls Hang is a survival psychological horror game where you investigate a place plagued by strange and unsettling events filled with hanging dolls. Explore dangerous locations, gather evidence, uncover hidden secrets, and use your boat to confront the unknown as you search for answers.

games.name: Where Noble Plans Lie
games.summary: Build-up your territory, your team of advisors, and your reputation as you bring every other noble to ruin at the behest of the Vampire Queen. Make the kingdom yours in the city-builder and turn-based RPG: Where Noble Plans Lie!

games.name: Where the Chips Fall
games.summary: Balatro Meets Blackjack with a Cuphead aesthetic in this casino rogue-lite where you gamble with you abilities. Every chip you bet can turn the tide in your favor, but you could also lose it all in a bad hand. Think you can beat the house?

games.name: Which Sea Is This?
games.summary: Which Sea Is This? is a local co-op sea adventure where you control a single ship together. Trade, explore, pirate, and argue about directions — because nobody knows where you are.

games.name: Whiplash
games.summary: WHIPLASH is a speedrunning FPS where game-changing weapon mods turn ordinary guns into overpowered builds. Craft the perfect loadout, master each course, and chase the perfect run.

games.name: Whisk
games.summary: Whisk is a two-player platformer about shared movement and communication. Coordinate jumps, climbs and throws with a partner to get every Dreamcat home.

games.name: Whiskers In The Sand
games.summary: Whiskers In The Sand is a fast-paced survivors-like arena roguelite where battle-ready cats shred through hordes of undead desert monsters. Unlock new cats, collect relics, stack upgrades, and forge ridiculous builds to survive the pharaoh's second reign.

games.name: Whiskers Wonderland
games.summary: Whiskers Wonderland: a game where your pops sent you to find something that was lost in a restaurant, but be warned, Mr Whiskers doesn't like trespassers and you unfortunately are one, so he's after you... You do remember another robot named Dr Mouser. Ready to find what happend to him?

games.name: Whiskers and Wizardry
games.summary: Step into the magical paws of an overconfident wizard cat in this action-packed roguelite! Craft unique spells, battle hordes of minions and powerful bosses, cleanse the forest of evil, and rescue your Human Wizard Owner. From the creators of Margoq's Lair, a studio focused on roguelite games.

games.name: Whispers of Appalachia
games.summary: An atmospheric horror walking simulator inspired by Appalachian folklore. Explore a hostile forest, survive multiple nights, and avoid the creatures that roam within. No puzzles. No combat. Just you, the forest, and what hunts inside it.

games.name: Whispers of the Tallgrass
games.summary: An atmospheric first-person survival horror set in an abandoned industrial wasteland overtaken by tall grass. Listen closely to the mysterious sounds of the night, hide from a relentless predator, scavenge for key items, uncover the secrets of this place, and find a way to escape.

games.name: White Rats
games.summary:
White Rats is a sci-fi survival visual novel set within the cold, decaying corridors of the research station UF-44.
When a group of survivors wakes up with fragmented memories and no clear way out, they must uncover the truth behind the station’s secrets — and the experiments that took place there.

Choices matter: each decision can lead to survival... or something far worse.
Investigate, adapt, and try to keep your mind intact as reality begins to twist.

Will you solve the mystery — or become just another test subject?

games.name: Who Wants To Be King?!
games.summary: The year is 865. Vikings are sailing to avenge Ragnar Lothbrok. Build your city and defend it—alone or with friends.

games.name: Wiblu
games.summary: Wiblu: The Search for the Fire Tea, is a captivating video game with German mythology, following Wiblu's quest to find the legendary Fire Tea to save her sick grandmother.

games.name: Wiffleball Legends
games.summary: Swing for the fences and become a backyard hero! Throw insane curve balls and other crazy wiffleball pitches in this 4v4 wiffleball game! Build your dream team to win a championship in season mode, crush home runs in a home run derby mode and lead your team to the national championship in Story Mode

games.name: Wild Haven
games.summary: Wild Haven is a nature ecosystem builder. You will build the forest and create a thriving ecosystem. Clean up polluted land, strategically place wildlife together, discover more complex plants and animals and rebuild the ecosystem your way!

games.name: Wild Terrain
games.summary: You're a wild pig on a quest to find all of your missing piglets. Smash obstacles, forage through trash for food, discover special mushrooms, and poop flowers to restore balance as you grow closer to your piglet family and the wild around you.

games.name: Wild West Pioneers
games.summary: Follow the American dream and start settling in the frontier with the city-builder Wild West Pioneers. Build and manage your ever-growing villages, establish production chains as well as outposts and build trade routes to support your cities and outposts.

games.name: Wildekin
games.summary: Wildekin is a 3D pixel-art adventure where up to 4 friends can build, explore, survive and thrive—or at least try to before some creature tries to turn you into a light snack!

games.name: Wilderlocke
games.summary: WILDERLOCKE is a tactical monster-taming roguelike. Build up a team of diverse & powerful monsters. Find the perfect combinations of moves, passives & stats to create devastating synergies. Triumph in increasingly challenging 2v2 turn-based battles and become unstoppable.

games.name: Windwalkers: Below the Storm
games.summary: Lead high-risk surface rescue operations across a storm-scarred Earth. Power your rover, tools, and modular pack with limited energy resources as you recover survivors, salvage critical supplies, and help reclaim the world above.

games.name: Windwoven
games.summary: You inherit forest edge land. Daily, till soil with your hoe grow radishes, rear chicks, bond with oddball neighbors. Spring seeds yield summer gardens; autumn's firelit pumpkins reveal woodland mysteries. Nighttime under trees, fireflies dance like starlit constellations, this is your idyllic life.

games.name: Wing-It
games.summary: Adapt or crash! WING-IT is a 2.5D shooter where your arsenal is a slot machine. Shoot down drones to trigger the Toy Box Gacha and swap weapons on the fly. Fight through Medy's house, survive the bullet hell, and defeat the mechanical monstrosities ruling the house.

games.name: Wingmine
games.summary:
Wingmine is a narrative puzzle game inspired by Minesweeper, entirely based on logic.
Your special unit has been scattered behind enemy lines: analyze the terrain, defuse the mines, and save your team.

games.name: Winter Whiskers
games.summary: In this cozy snow-cleaning adventure, help bring Winterlight Harbor back to life after a sudden blizzard! Vacuum up snow, turn it into steam, and power the town. Melt icy paths, help your neighbors, and prepare for the Winter Festival!

games.name: Wire Throne
games.summary: Blast your way out of captivity, upgrade your ride, and unleash devastating firepower to take down the Wire Throne! One life, one car in this roguelite top-down looter shooter!

games.name: Wish Of Hers
games.summary:
Wish of Hers is a round-based 2.5D roguelike about surviving in unstable dreams.
Each run is shaped by unlocked abilities, combined aspects, and your decisions.
Experiment, adapt, and break your own builds!

games.name: Wish Upon a Llama
games.summary: Embark on a delightful journey of breeding and raising adorable animals like llamas, bunnies, and capybaras while building meaningful relationships with the residents of Llama Town. What unique animal breeds will you discover and whom among the townsfolk will you befriend? Adventure awaits!

games.name: Witch the Showdown
games.summary: A high-difficulty action game combining parry mechanics and deck-building. Fight your way through and aim to become the champion of the tournament.

games.name: Witchbrook
games.summary: Experience the thrills and pitfalls of school-life in Witchbrook! Discover a spellbinding isometric pixel art world full of charm and intrigue in this richly detailed magical school and town life simulator.

games.name: With Dream
games.summary: This is a story about two doctors who travel back in time to fulfill the last wish of a dying old man.

games.name: Withering State
games.summary: Act as Premier Alexander Sants in a time of stagnation, division, and the falling of walls. Will you steer the brotherly nations of the People's Republic of Sudlivia toward the liberal West, reinforce the crumbling East, or forge a new path? Or even be ousted before becoming the General Secretary?

games.name: Within
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the atmospheric world of a first-person thriller. You will face a cunning criminal. Explore locations, solve puzzles, and try to escape the nightmare. But be careful: you can become not only the hunter but also the prey.

games.name: Wiz Hunter
games.summary: Wiz Hunter is a rogue-lite deckbuilding card game. Embark on a deadly quest to hunt down wizards through strategic, turn-based combat. Kill, die, learn, repeat.

games.name: Woe Reigns Unending
games.summary: Lead a cursed party through a ruined world in this grimdark side-scrolling RPG. Build your team, master tactical combat, and unleash forbidden powers to survive an endless parade of nightmares. Decide what, if anything, is worth salvaging from a world that has been reduced to ashes.

games.name: Wonderfall
games.summary: A third-person adventure game in a dystopian 1920s Paris consumed by Entropy. As buildings crumble into sand, Léon, a young orphan with the ability to manipulate this sand embark on a quest for truth and confront the remains of a city collapsing beneath his feet.

games.name: Wonderland Quest
games.summary: Wonderland Quest is a casual point & click adventure game. Travel across Wonderland teeming with colorful challenges, surprises and creatures, brought to life with beautiful artwork.

games.name: Wong
games.summary: Wong is a 2D platformer designed for speedrunning, where you will clear levels, learn their shortcuts, and compete for the best score in a fluid, precise, and perfection-focused gameplay experience.

games.name: Work In Progress
games.summary:
It’s your first day in office and half of the staff is already on burnout...
Here is your gun, your contract.
Now go fire some people.

games.name: World In The Abyss
games.summary: The aliens have caused the oceans to rise, plunging the world into the abyss. Survive, craft, and explore this mysterious underwater world. Build your base, defend it against relentless waves of enemies, and dive deep to uncover the secret that could stop the alien invasion once and for all!

games.name: World Inverted
games.summary: The sky lies beneath our feet. Above stretches a vast plane. From it hang forests of inverted buildings, linked by narrow corridors and pipes. They stand in silence, like upside-down obelisks pointing toward the eye of the sun. This game reveals an upside-down world through words and unique visuals.

games.name: World Without Time
games.summary: World without Time is an atmospheric adventure about a fire alicorn exploring a ruined world, using magic, and confronting their past self. Experience exploration, flight, light combat, and choices that shape the fate of the protagonist.

games.name: World of Dogs
games.summary: WORLD OF DOGS is a high-velocity immersive sim where speed isn’t balanced—it’s weaponized. You are the first fully grafted human, stitched together from dead champions, dumped into a collapsing city where every faction is fighting for a future that hates you.

games.name: Wrong Treatment
games.summary: Wrong Treatment is a psychological horror survival game where the protagonist's mind becomes the main setting.

games.name: Wǔxíng Yóu
games.summary: A Zen spell game based on the Five Elements Theory.

games.name: Xanniban
games.summary: Evil has been unleashed. Don the Trespasser's suit as you dash across facilities, manage resources, and confine hostile machines to change the fate of humanity. Lure your foes into containment as a grim epidemic festers beneath the surface...

games.name: XenoFeels
games.summary: A space customs simulator. Every day, spaceships from different galaxies fly past your tiny asteroid. Tourists, truckers, travelers... Bad news: There are terrorists among them. If you miss even one, your home planet will explode. Good news: You carry a shotgun!

games.name: Yami Kids
games.summary: Play as "The Yami Twins" and uncover the mystery behind your family's killers. Yami Kids is a tale of tragedy, familial bonds, and revenge. Face off against trainers in "Shadow Duels", and make contracts with Oni to aid you on your quest.

games.name: Yami Mura
games.summary: Emica awakens in her city's train station, compelled to walk through darkness and the anxiety of being stranded in a strange world. She must escape by solving puzzles.

games.name: You Remembered
games.summary: Type letters that fall and become part of the world. Use their shape and attributes to navigate the puzzles and secrets.

games.name: You Sure Wanna Drink This?
games.summary: Dive into a whimsical turn-based RPG where logic meets alchemy! When a mysterious force steals all potion-making knowledge, you’ll master remedies on the fly! Analyze bizarre ingredients, reverse-engineer their effects, and craft tactical potions to outsmart enemies.

games.name: You're Nuts!
games.summary: Escape from a decaying industrial maze where logic is the only way out. Scout for shortcuts, scavenge parts to craft upgrades and make sure to come back to your safety hub each day to protect your cover. A cozy co-op adventure for 1-4 sentient robots. Can you find the key and reach the exit in time?

games.name: Your Forever Friend
games.summary: Your Forever Friend is the solution to never feeling alone again! Play video games, listen to music together, reminisce about buried memories... And there's absolutely nothing wrong with it. NOTHING ! <3

games.name: Your Judgment, Inquisitor
games.summary: Your judgment, Inquisitor Medieval Spain. You serve as an Inquisitor in the shadow of the dreaded Tomás de Torquemada. Cast out demons from the possessed. Burn heretics. Spare the innocent — or condemn them. Every wrong choice will bring you closer to the wrath of the Church… or the fury of the mob.

games.name: Your Painting, Sir
games.summary: Recreate paintings using newspaper cutouts — Analyze the painting, search the newspaper for similar elements, carefully cut them out, and place them on their correct position. Will you fool your boss with your arts and crafts?

games.name: Your World
games.summary: Create beautiful multiplayer worlds, games, simulators, and theme parks with this easy-to-use sandbox title.

games.name: Yuha's Nightmares
games.summary: This is a simulation game about the nightmares that our main character Yuha suffers from. You will explore the surrealistic world that is full of unexpected events. The deeper part of Yuha's consciousness is depicted through the flip side of the 3D world.

games.name: Zaibaly
games.summary: Horror-comedy boomer shooter, fantastic reimagining of a real-life experience of living under the constant threat of aerial assault

games.name: Zaleste
games.summary: Shmup collaboration between Compile Heart and M2.

games.name: Zeizen
games.summary: Ultra-violent point & click set in Shanghai, China.

games.name: ZeroPrompt
games.summary: The internet is dying. You're a verification operator. Filter out AI impostors from humanity's last clean network. Interrogate live LLM agents that think, lie, and bribe in real-time. Use investigation tools to detect deception. Every verdict shapes the internet.

games.name: Zeta Wolf Chronicles
games.summary: "Date" one of four girls on the path to enlightenment. Prom awaits. Will you be led astray by an old crush? The realistic dating-sim that "teaches" through its gameplay. Follow Rayen, a young disillusioned teen as he attempts to romance girls based on e-book tutorials. Will desperation win out in this desire for love, or will knowledge, patience, and logic pave the way to success?

games.name: Zolana: Girl Galactic
games.summary: Saving Planet Earth, one outfit at a time! Zolana must save the planet Earth from having its fashion taken away, by challenging the Uniforian conquerors to a runway competition! Dress to a new theme each round in order to wow the judges and save the day!

games.name: Zombie Craft
games.summary: Zombie Craft is an open-world survival, farming, ranching, factory-building, and trading game inspired by many beloved classics. Explore the continent freely, rebuild villages, and earn your fortune. And whatever you do—prepare for the night. They are coming.

games.name: Zombie Typing
games.summary: Zombie Typing is a tense survival game where every action: moving, looting, reloading, and fighting off the undead, relies on your typing skills. Type fast and stay sharp, because one wrong key could mean the difference between survival and being devoured!

games.name: Zozo and the Lost Dreams
games.summary: Help Zozo find his way home in this cartoon-inspired Metroidvania platformer. Pillow-fight sentient pastries, train under an octopus master, and brave a cybernetic jungle as you explore the vibrant landscapes of Zozo's dreams.

games.name: Zwaard
games.summary: Explore a world where you try to preserve the still existing life forms. Technology has taken over and will try it's best to stop you in your adventure. Whilst those technologies try to stop you they could also be the only reason you're still alive.

games.name: [Redacted]
games.summary: You're a government officer. Documents hit your desk, you scrub out the secrets, and you hope nothing leaks. Miss a word? Maybe it's fine. Miss a few? Well, ██████████. You've got limited ink, limited time, and frankly, limited ████████████. Cheaper than a ████████████.
